cue: choice between a certain payoff and a gamble whose outcome probabilities are known or unknown
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：确定收益 vs 概率已知/未知的赌局（Hsu et al. 2005，R1152）。本包仅此一个配置。

cue: two visually presented word pairs (A:B :: C:D)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：判断两词对是否关系相同，对照为语义关联判断（Bunge et al. 2005，R1150）。本包仅此一个配置。

classes: no cue; centre cue; double cue; spatial cue; congruent flankers; incongruent flankers; neutral flankers
cue: visual warning/spatial cues (asterisks) preceding a central arrow flanked by arrows or lines
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：4 种视觉线索 × 3 种 flanker 条件（classes 列出两个因素的水平），得出警觉、定向、执行控制三个分数（Fan et al. 2002，R0234）。

classes: warning tone; no tone; valid cue; invalid cue; no cue; congruent flankers; incongruent flankers
cue: auditory alerting tone and peripheral visual cues of varying validity preceding arrow flankers
distinguishing: 准则 2：警觉信号改为听觉提示音；准则 1：定向线索引入有效/无效条件（CTL-ANT-001 为视觉警觉线索、只有有效的空间线索）。

cue: peripheral visual target onset; instruction to look towards (pro) or to the mirror location (anti)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：外周目标出现后向镜像位置扫视（Hallett 1978，R0045）；与前向扫视混合或分组只是参数。

name_zh: 替代用途任务（发散思维）
cue: name of an everyday object presented visually; covert generation of uses within a time limit
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早神经记录线索）：给出日常物品，限时生成新用途，与较低创造性要求的对照任务比较（Fink et al. 2009，R1151）。本包仅此一个配置。

cue: virtual balloon inflated by key presses; money accrues per pump and is lost if the balloon bursts
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：自定步调地充气或兑现，气球在随机爆点爆炸（Lejuez et al. 2002，R0224）；fMRI 版（ds000001）只改参数。
datasets: Balloon Analog Risk-taking Task (OpenfMRI)

classes: warning S1 followed by imperative S2
cue: auditory or visual warning stimulus (S1) followed after a fixed interval by an imperative stimulus (S2) requiring a speeded response
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：固定 S1–S2 间隔的预警反应时任务（Walter et al. 1964，R0010）。本包仅此一个配置。

name_zh: 决策信心判断（知觉元认知）
cue: two-choice perceptual stimulus followed by a confidence rating from certainly wrong to certainly correct
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：每次知觉判断后作从"肯定错"到"肯定对"的信心评分（Boldt & Yeung 2015，R1145）。本包仅此一个配置。

cue: rapid stream of single letters; respond to the target letter
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：在快速字母流中对目标字母作反应（Rosvold et al. 1956，R0003）。

cue: letter cue followed by letter probe after a delay
distinguishing: 准则 1：条件集由"目标/非目标"变为 AX、AY、BX、BY 四种线索–探测组合，目标定义取决于前一线索（CTL-CPT-001 为单一目标字母）。

name_zh: 渐变呈现持续操作任务（gradCPT）
classes: frequent scene category (respond); rare scene category (withhold)
cue: scene images gradually transitioning from one to the next
distinguishing: 准则 2、3：刺激为渐变过渡的场景图片、无离散刺激起始，按连续时间序列分析注意状态（CTL-CPT-001 为离散字母流的目标检测）。

cue: pairs of monetary amounts with delays
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：反复在较小的即时奖赏与较大的延迟奖赏间选择以求无差异点（Rachlin et al. 1991，R1134）。本包仅此一个配置。

cue: two stimuli each requiring its own speeded response, separated by a variable stimulus onset asynchrony
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：心理不应期范式，两刺激间 SOA 可变（Telford 1931，R1135）；SOA 取值是参数。

classes: low-effort / low-reward option; high-effort / high-reward option
cue: choice screen with reward magnitude and probability; effort is button pressing
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：EEfRT，按键努力程度不同的两选项在不同奖赏概率下选择（Treadway et al. 2009，R0451）。本包仅此一个配置；认知努力折扣（R0437、R0639）未拆分，待核对。

cue: central target letter flanked by noise letters assigned to the same or the other response
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：中央目标字母两侧为与其同反应或异反应的干扰字母（Eriksen & Eriksen 1974，R0030）。

cue: central arrow flanked by arrows pointing in the same or opposite direction
distinguishing: 准则 2：刺激为箭头（方向判断），刺激–反应映射直接由箭头方向给出（CTL-FLK-001 为字母目标与干扰字母，映射需学习）。
datasets: ERP CORE (flankers paradigm: ERN and LRP)

classes: engage with current offer; search for alternatives
cue: offer and environment of alternative options with a search cost
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：接受当前选项或付出代价搜索（Kolling et al. 2012，R1147）。本包仅此一个配置。

cue: frequent Go and infrequent NoGo stimuli
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：对 Go 刺激反应、对 NoGo 刺激抑制（Donders 1868/1969，R0019）；Go/NoGo 比例、刺激种类（字母、情绪面孔）只是参数。

classes: deck A; deck B; deck C; deck D
cue: four card decks with different gain/loss schedules
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：四副牌，两副短期高收益但长期亏损（Bechara et al. 1994，R0116）。本包仅此一个配置。

cue: 50/50 gambles combining independently varied potential gain and loss
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：接受或拒绝得失独立变化的 50/50 混合赌局（Tom et al. 2007，R1146）。本包仅此一个配置。
datasets: Mixed-gambles task (OpenfMRI)

cue: briefly presented masked arrow prime followed by a visible arrow target
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：掩蔽箭头启动刺激与可见目标相容/不相容（Eimer & Schlaghecken 1998，R1144）；启动–目标间隔是参数。

cue: three digits; report the identity of the digit that differs
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：三位数字中报告不同的那个，干扰与控制试次分组块呈现（Bush et al. 2003 线索 R1143）；组块设计待核对原文。

name_zh: 知觉决策（随机点运动，按试次）
cue: random-dot kinematogram with a variable fraction of coherently moving dots
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：每个试次呈现一段随机点运动，报告净运动方向（Britten et al. 1992，R0102，动物源头）。

name_zh: 连续监视随机点运动任务
classes: leftward coherent motion; rightward coherent motion
cue: continuous random-dot display with embedded, unannounced periods of coherent motion
distinguishing: 准则 3：连续监视、目标出现没有试次起始标记（CTL-PDM-001 为按试次呈现的随机点运动）。

cue: three visually presented cue words; find a fourth word associated with each
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：三个线索词找共同联想词（Mednick 1962，R0008）；顿悟报告是附加测量，不另给号。

cue: matrix of geometric patterns with one missing cell and response options
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：选择补全矩阵的图块（Penrose & Raven 1936，R1137）；神经影像中的计算机化版本只改呈现参数。

cue: pacing tone; generate numbers as randomly as possible or count
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：按节拍声随机生成数字，与计数对照，PET 组块设计（Jahanshahi et al. 2000，R1149）；节拍速率是参数。

cue: single digits at a fixed rapid rate
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：对所有数字反应、对罕见目标数字抑制（Robertson et al. 1997，R0139）。本包仅此一个配置。

cue: auditory stimuli presented to the left or right ear; response to a non-spatial feature with a left or right key
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：听觉刺激呈现于左/右耳，按非空间特征作左/右反应（Simon & Rudell 1967，R0016）。

cue: coloured visual stimuli at lateral screen positions; colour-to-key mapping
distinguishing: 准则 2：刺激为左右视野中的彩色视觉刺激（CTL-SIM-001 为左右耳的听觉刺激）。

cue: go stimulus followed on a minority of trials by a stop signal after a variable delay
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：少数试次在可变延迟后出现停止信号，按赛跑模型估计 SSRT（Logan & Cowan 1984，R0067）；延迟固定或阶梯追踪是参数。

name_zh: Stroop 任务（卡片版，口头命名）
classes: naming ink colours of incongruent colour words; naming colour patches
cue: cards or lists of colour words printed in incongruent ink colours, or colour patches; serial vocal naming
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：整张卡片/列表连续口头命名，以完成时间计干扰（Stroop 1935，R0002）。

name_zh: Stroop 任务（单试次计算机化颜色词）
cue: single colour word per trial in congruent or incongruent ink colour
distinguishing: 准则 3：单试次呈现、逐试次反应（CTL-STR-001 为整张卡片/列表连续命名的组块结构）；按键或口头反应、是否含中性试次只是参数。

cue: task indicated by the stimulus position in a predictable AABB sequence; no explicit task cue
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：可预测的 AABB 交替序列，任务由位置决定、无显式线索（Rogers & Monsell 1995，R0121）。

cue: explicit task cue on every trial (e.g., word 'colour' or 'shape') followed by a bivalent target; random task sequence
distinguishing: 准则 2：每试次有显式任务线索、任务顺序随机（CTL-SW-001 为可预测 AABB 序列、无线索）；线索–刺激间隔是参数。

cue: bivalent target without task cue; participant selects the task (e.g., by response hand)
distinguishing: 准则 2、3：没有外部任务线索或预定序列，任务由被试逐试次自主选择（CTL-SW-001 为预定 AABB 序列，CTL-SW-002 为外部线索）。

cue: visually presented syllogisms with concrete, abstract or belief-laden content
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：判断三段论结论是否有效，内容具体/抽象/与信念相关（Goel et al. 2000，R1153）；内容类型是条件水平，不另给号。

cue: start and goal arrangements of coloured balls on pegs of different capacity; problems graded by minimum number of moves
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：把起始状态的彩球移成目标状态，难度按最少步数（Shallice 1982，R0057）。计算机化与 Stockings of Cambridge 等版本未拆分（无线索核对其配置差异）。

name_zh: 基于价值的选择（支付意愿）
cue: images of food items; bid in an incentive-compatible Becker-DeGroot-Marschak auction
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：对食物出价的 BDM 拍卖（Plassmann et al. 2007，R1148）。本包仅此一个配置。

cue: four cards and a conditional rule ('if P then Q'); select cards to test the rule
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：四卡选择任务（Wason 1966，R0015）；抽象 vs 主题/社会交换内容（R0058、R0089）是内容条件，未拆分。

classes: sort by colour; sort by shape; sort by number
cue: response cards matched to key cards; right/wrong feedback; rule changes without warning
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：按颜色/形状/数量分类，规则由反馈推断且无预告地改变（Grant & Berg 1948，R1136）。本包仅此一个配置。

classes: valence-congruent prime-target pair; valence-incongruent prime-target pair
cue: briefly presented prime word followed by a target word that is classified as positive or negative (evaluative decision)
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): evaluative-decision affective priming with word primes and targets (Fazio et al. 1986, R0074).

classes: emotional memory recall; neutral memory recall
cue: cue words prompting retrieval of a specific personal memory
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): cue-word autobiographical recall of emotional versus neutral episodes (cue-word method of R0073); no external affective stimulus.

classes: probe at emotional-cue location; probe at neutral-cue location
cue: pair of words (one threat-related, one neutral) followed by a dot probe at one of the two locations
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): word-pair dot-probe task (MacLeod, Mathews & Tata 1986, R0072).

cue: coloured words; the ink colour is named or reported by key press
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): colour naming of emotional versus neutral words; origin publication still TBD (D-032).

classes: emotional expression faces; neutral expression faces
cue: photographs of faces presented one at a time, with passive viewing or an orthogonal task
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): event-related presentation of single emotional versus neutral faces with an orthogonal or passive task (ERP lead R0846). Differs from EMO-FACE-002 (blocked face-versus-shape matching).

cue: triads of angry or fearful faces, or of geometric shapes, with a task cue before each block
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 3 versus EMO-FACE-001: blocked face-versus-shape matching contrast instead of event-related emotional-versus-neutral faces (Hariri et al. 2002).

classes: CS+ (paired with aversive US); CS- (never paired)
cue: neutral visual conditioned stimuli, with a mild electric shock or loud noise as unconditioned stimulus
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): single-session differential conditioning with one CS+ and one CS-, acquisition followed by extinction (lead R0951; authors not in literature.csv). Differs from EMO-FC-002 (graded generalization stimuli) and EMO-FC-003 (extinction recall on a separate day).

name_zh: 恐惧泛化（CS 相似度梯度）
cue: series of perceptually graded stimuli spanning the CS+ and CS-; aversive US on CS+ trials
distinguishing: Criterion 1 versus EMO-FC-001: the condition set adds graded generalization stimuli between CS+ and CS-, so the contrast is a similarity gradient rather than CS+ versus CS- (lead R1010).

name_zh: 两日恐惧条件化与消退回忆
name_en: Two-day fear conditioning with extinction recall
cue: visual CS with shock US on day 1; same CS without US at the recall test
distinguishing: Criterion 3 versus EMO-FC-001: multi-session structure with acquisition and extinction on one day and an extinction-recall test on a later day (leads R0276, R0933).

name_zh: 影片片段离散情绪诱发
classes: film clips targeting discrete emotions (one target emotion per clip); neutral film clips
cue: validated short film clips, each selected to elicit one discrete emotion, followed by self-report
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): standardised film set targeting discrete emotions with self-report after each clip (lead R0918, Cognition and Emotion, doi 10.1080/02699939508408966; authors not in literature.csv). Differs from EMO-FILM-002 (music videos with dimensional ratings), -003 (three valence classes) and -004 (four emotion classes).

name_zh: 音乐视频情绪诱发（维度评定）
name_en: Music-video emotion elicitation with dimensional ratings
classes: valence rating; arousal rating; dominance rating; liking rating
cue: one-minute music-video excerpts, each followed by self-assessment
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 2 versus EMO-FILM-001: targets are continuous self-rated dimensions (valence, arousal, dominance, liking) rather than discrete emotion categories, and the stimuli are music videos rather than film clips (DEAP, Koelstra et al. 2012).
datasets: DEAP: a database for emotion analysis using physiological signals; AMIGOS: A Dataset for Affect, Personality and Mood Research on Individuals and Groups

name_zh: 影片片段三分类效价诱发（SEED）
cue: film clips, each preceded by a hint and followed by self-assessment
distinguishing: Criterion 1 versus EMO-FILM-001: three valence classes (positive, neutral, negative) instead of a set of discrete target emotions; used by the public SEED dataset (Zheng & Lu 2015).
datasets: SEED (SJTU Emotion EEG Dataset)

name_zh: 影片片段四分类情绪诱发（SEED-IV）
cue: film clips with self-assessment; eye tracking recorded alongside EEG
distinguishing: Criterion 1 versus EMO-FILM-001 and EMO-FILM-003: four emotion classes (happy, sad, fear, neutral); used by the public SEED-IV dataset.
datasets: SEED-IV

cue: cartoons with funniness rating
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): funny versus non-funny cartoon viewing with ratings (Mobbs et al. 2003, R1184).

classes: pleasant pictures; neutral pictures; unpleasant pictures
cue: affective pictures (IAPS) shown for a few seconds each, often followed by ratings
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): passive viewing of pleasant, neutral and unpleasant pictures (ERP lead R0865).

classes: potential monetary gain; potential monetary loss; no incentive
cue: abstract shape cues signalling the monetary incentive, then a briefly presented target
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): monetary incentive delay task with gain, loss and neutral cues and per-trial outcome feedback (Knutson et al. 2000, R0193). Differs from EMO-MID-002 (social reward cues and feedback).

cue: cues announcing social reward, then a target; outcome shown as a facial expression
distinguishing: Criterion 2 versus EMO-MID-001: incentive cues and outcome feedback are social (facial approval) instead of monetary (Spreckelmeyer et al. 2009, R0426).

cue: instruction cue followed by a negative picture, then affect rating
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): two-condition look-versus-reappraise design with negative pictures (Ochsner et al. 2002, R0232). Differs from EMO-REG-002 (reappraisal contrasted with expressive suppression).

name_zh: 认知重评与表达抑制对比
cue: instruction cue followed by a negative emotional stimulus
distinguishing: Criterion 1 versus EMO-REG-001: the condition set adds expressive suppression as a second regulation strategy (lead R1065; multi-strategy designs in R0599).

cue: spoken sentences or pseudo-sentences with emotional or neutral prosody
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): emotional versus neutral speech prosody with passive listening or emotion identification; origin publication TBD (first_source holds an early ERP study, D-031).

classes: pre-stress baseline; anticipation, public speech and mental arithmetic before an evaluative panel; recovery
cue: live evaluative panel; speech preparation, free speech and serial subtraction
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): Trier Social Stress Test with a live panel (Kirschbaum et al. 1993, R0108). Differs from EMO-STRESS-002 (in-scanner arithmetic with time limits and performance feedback).

name_zh: 蒙特利尔影像应激任务（MIST）
classes: rest; control arithmetic (no time limit, no evaluation); experimental arithmetic (adaptive time limit, social-evaluative feedback)
cue: on-screen arithmetic with a progress bar and a performance indicator
distinguishing: Criteria 1, 2 and 4 versus EMO-STRESS-001: computerised in-scanner arithmetic with rest and control conditions instead of a live panel, and per-item performance feedback (Dedovic et al. 2005).

classes: neutral (no shock); predictable shock (cued); unpredictable shock
cue: visual cues within condition blocks; shocks delivered only during cues (P) or at any time (U)
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): NPU-threat test contrasting predictable and unpredictable threat with a neutral condition (Schmitz & Grillon 2012 protocol paper, sprint-2 S2-04).

name_zh: 情感触觉（C 触觉纤维最适触摸）
classes: CT-optimal slow stroking on hairy skin; control touch (faster stroking or glabrous skin)
cue: soft brush strokes delivered by an experimenter or robot
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): slow brush stroking versus control touch (Olausson et al. 2002, R1183).

classes: positive words; negative words; neutral words
cue: words presented in a rapid serial stream during silent reading
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): rapid serial presentation of emotional and neutral words during reading (Kissler et al. 2007, R1181).

name_zh: 音高偏移听觉反馈（言语运动误差）
classes: upward pitch shift; downward pitch shift
cue: brief real-time pitch shift of the participant's own voice heard through headphones during sustained vowel production
distinguishing: 标准配置：持续元音发声时，耳机中实时回放的自身嗓音被短暂上移或下移音高（闭环听觉反馈扰动）。出处未定（TBD，见 first_source）；本包仅此一个配置。

classes: veridical cursor feedback; rotated cursor feedback
cue: visual reach targets; cursor feedback of hand position rotated relative to the actual movement direction
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：伸手/光标运动中施加视觉旋转，被试依据光标位置的感觉误差逐渐适应（Krakauer et al. 2000，R0194）。光标反馈为连续或仅终点显示的区别待核对原文（见 split_log 待例会行）。

name_zh: 基于奖赏的运动学习（二值反馈）
cue: reach target; binary colour feedback without cursor or hand-position information
distinguishing: 准则 4：反馈为二值奖赏（成功/失败），不显示手或光标位置（ERR-ADAPT-001 为旋转光标的感觉误差反馈）。

name_zh: 食欲性巴甫洛夫条件化（时间差分预测误差）
classes: expected reward delivery; reward omission; unexpected reward delivery
cue: visual conditioned stimuli predicting delivery of a pleasant taste
distinguishing: 标准配置：视觉条件刺激预测味觉奖赏，偶尔省略或意外给予奖赏，不要求反应（O'Doherty et al. 2003 线索 S_ODOHERTY2003）。本包仅此一个配置。

name_zh: 错误觉知（选择任务 + 正确性判断）
name_en: Error awareness (choice task with accuracy judgements)
classes: correct response; aware (signalled) error; unaware error
cue: visual speeded choice stimuli (flanker-type arrays) followed by a post-response judgement of response accuracy
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：快速手动选择任务后，每次反应都作正确性判断，据此把错误分为觉察/未觉察（Scheffers & Coles 2000，R0195）。

name_zh: 反向眼跳任务中的错误觉知
name_en: Error awareness in the antisaccade task
classes: correct antisaccade; aware (signalled) error; unaware error
cue: peripheral visual target; antisaccade instruction; error signalling after each trial
distinguishing: 准则 2：刺激与反应换为反向眼跳（眼动反应、外周目标），错误为反射性前向扫视（ERR-AWARE-001 为手动选择任务）。

classes: correct Go; correct NoGo; aware commission error; unaware commission error
cue: serial colour words (congruent or incongruent font colour); separate error-signalling button on the next trial
distinguishing: 准则 1、2：Go/NoGo 结构，错误是抑制失败（误按），用 Stroop 式颜色词作刺激，觉知用下一试次的错误报告键标示（ERR-AWARE-001 为选择任务 + 每次正确性判断）。

cue: four visual options (slot machines) whose payoffs drift over trials
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：四臂"不安定"老虎机，各臂报酬随时间漂移，每次选择后给出点数反馈（Daw et al. 2006，R0338）。本包仅此一个配置。

cue: sequences of cue or action and outcome events with manipulated contingency, followed by causal or contingency judgements
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早行为学线索）：动作/线索与结果事件的统计关联被操纵，被试判断因果强度（Dickinson et al. 1984，R0066）。本包仅此一个配置。

name_zh: 预测推断任务（变点条件）
cue: on each trial a prediction of the next outcome location, followed by the observed outcome drawn from a distribution whose mean shifts at unsignalled change points
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：结果分布的均值在无提示的变点处突变，只有变点一种生成条件（Nassar et al. 2010，R1138）。
datasets: Nassar, Bruckner & Frank 2019 behavioural and EEG data (Dryad)

name_zh: 预测推断任务（oddball 条件）
cue: prediction of next outcome location followed by the observed outcome; blocks of change-point or oddball generative statistics
distinguishing: 准则 1：条件集由单一变点条件扩为变点 + oddball 两种生成统计（ERR-CHGPT-001 只有变点条件）。
datasets: Nassar, Bruckner & Frank 2019 behavioural and EEG data (Dryad)

name_zh: 交互式错误电位（离散用户指令）
classes: correct interface action; erroneous interface action
cue: user issues discrete commands (e.g., key presses) to move a cursor towards a target; the interface executes the opposite action on a fixed proportion of trials
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：用户发出离散指令移动光标，界面以固定概率执行相反动作（模拟 BCI 交互），错误反馈锁时诱发 ErrP（Ferrez & Millán 2008，R0403）。

name_zh: 监视型错误电位（自主运行设备）
classes: correct device movement; erroneous device movement
cue: cursor or device moving autonomously step by step towards a target, without user commands
distinguishing: 准则 3：试次中没有用户指令阶段，用户只监视自主运行的设备（ERR-ERRP-001 中错误是对用户离散指令的错误执行）。
datasets: BNCI Horizon 2020 013-2015: Monitoring error-related potentials (64-channel EEG)

name_zh: P300 拼写器反馈错误电位
classes: correct character feedback; erroneous character feedback
cue: visual feedback of the character selected by an online P300 speller
distinguishing: 准则 2：错误刺激是 P300 拼写器给出的字符反馈（真实解码错误、错误率由拼写器决定），而不是 ERR-ERRP-001 中按固定概率人为插入的光标动作错误。
datasets: BCI Challenge @ NER 2015 (Kaggle): error potential detection in an online P300 speller

name_zh: 连续反馈中的错误电位
classes: correct continuous feedback; execution error; outcome error
cue: continuous cursor control in a video game; errors inserted at unpredictable times
distinguishing: 准则 3、4：连续控制、无试次划分，反馈连续（ERR-ERRP-001 为离散指令与离散反馈）；准则 1：区分执行错误与结果错误两类错误。

cue: choice between two visual options labelled with monetary amounts, followed by gain/loss feedback
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：在两个标有金额的选项中选择，随后呈现得/失反馈，得失与表现基本无关（Gehring & Willoughby 2002，R0235）；金额大小是否作为因素与 ERR-GAM-002 相区别，待核对原文。

cue: two doors; pure guess; fixed-magnitude gain/loss arrows
distinguishing: 准则 2：刺激为两扇门与固定金额的得失箭头，纯猜测；准则 1：只有得/失两个条件，金额不作为因素（与 ERR-GAM-001 的金额标注选项相区别，后者金额因素待核对原文）。

cue: computer-generated slot-machine outcomes without a choice by the participant
distinguishing: 准则 3：试次中没有选择/反应阶段，结果与被试行为无关（ERR-GAM-001 先选择再得反馈）。

cue: visual stimuli chosen by the participant, each associated probabilistically with a rewarding outcome
distinguishing: 标准配置（首个人类 fMRI 线索）：被试通过选择学习动作–结果关联，结果给出奖赏反馈（O'Doherty et al. 2004，S_ODOHERTY2004）。本包仅此一个配置。

name_zh: 观察性错误（观察他人完成选择任务）
name_en: Observation of errors (human performer, choice task)
cue: observer watches another person perform a speeded choice (flanker) task and its responses, without acting
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：观察者观看另一名被试完成 Eriksen flanker 任务（van Schie et al. 2004，R0279；同类研究见 R0714 所列 Carp et al. 2009 等）。

name_zh: 观察他人 Go/NoGo 任务中的错误
name_en: Observation of errors in a Go/NoGo task
classes: observed correct Go; observed correct NoGo; observed commission error
cue: observer watches another person's Go/NoGo stimuli and responses
distinguishing: 准则 1、2：被观察的任务是 Go/NoGo，被观察的错误是抑制失败（误按），条件集含 Go/NoGo 两类刺激（ERR-OBS-001 观察的是选择任务中的选错）。

name_zh: 沉浸式 VR 中观察化身的动作错误
name_en: Observation of avatar action errors in immersive VR
classes: avatar correct action; avatar erroneous action
cue: avatar reach-to-grasp actions in immersive VR seen from first- or third-person perspective
distinguishing: 准则 2：被观察的刺激是 VR 中化身的伸手抓握动作（第一/第三人称视角），而不是 ERR-OBS-001 中他人在选择任务上的按键反应。

name_zh: 正交化 Go/NoGo 学习任务
classes: go to win; go to avoid losing; no-go to win; no-go to avoid losing
cue: four abstract visual cues, each assigned to one action (go/no-go) × outcome valence (win/avoid loss) combination
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表线索）：4 个线索分别对应 动作（做/不做）× 结果效价（得奖/免罚），由概率反馈学习（S_GUITARTMASIP_GNG）。本包仅此一个配置。

name_zh: 概率分类学习（天气预报任务）
cue: combinations of cue cards, each probabilistically related to one of two outcomes
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：天气预报任务，卡片组合概率性地预测两种结果之一，每次预测后给反馈（Knowlton et al. 1994，R0118）。本包仅此一个配置。

cue: two visual stimuli with probabilistic reward feedback; contingency reversed without warning
distinguishing: 标准配置（首个人类神经影像线索）：两刺激概率反馈学习，达到标准后无提示反转（Cools et al. 2002，R0223）。本包仅此一个配置。

name_zh: 概率奖赏任务（信号检测）
cue: briefly presented cartoon face with a short or long mouth; correct identifications of one stimulus rewarded more often
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：信号检测任务，两类刺激的正确识别以不对称比例给奖赏，产生反应偏向（Pizzagalli et al. 2005，S_PIZZAGALLI2005）。本包仅此一个配置。

classes: pair AB; pair CD; pair EF
cue: fixed visual stimulus pairs differing in reward probability during training; novel pairings without feedback at test
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：训练阶段 3 对固定刺激对的概率反馈学习，测试阶段新组合、无反馈（Frank et al. 2004，R0272）。本包仅此一个配置。

cue: cue to start an interval estimate (e.g., one second) by button press; feedback on whether the estimate fell within an adaptive window
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：时间估计后给出正确/错误反馈，时间窗自适应调整（Miltner et al. 1997，R0146）。本包仅此一个配置。

name_zh: 两阶段决策（基于模型/无模型）
classes: common transition, rewarded; common transition, unrewarded; rare transition, rewarded; rare transition, unrewarded
cue: first-stage choice between two options leading probabilistically (common/rare) to one of two second-stage states; second-stage choice rewarded with slowly drifting probabilities
distinguishing: 标准配置（公认标准两步任务）：第一阶段选择以常见/罕见转移进入第二阶段，第二阶段奖赏概率缓慢漂移（Daw et al. 2011，R0510）。

name_zh: 确定性转移两阶段任务
cue: two alternative first-stage states, each with two options leading deterministically to second-stage states with drifting point rewards
distinguishing: 准则 1、2：去掉常见/罕见转移（确定性转移），引入两个起始状态，奖赏为连续分数（ERR-TS-001 为概率转移与二值奖赏）。

name_zh: 虚拟现实视觉–触觉失配（预测误差负波）
classes: match (feedback at expected touch); mismatch (premature feedback)
cue: visual (and vibrotactile) touch feedback when reaching to tap a virtual object; on a minority of trials feedback is triggered prematurely
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：VR 中伸手触碰虚拟物体，少数试次的触碰反馈提前出现（失配，oddball 结构）（Gehrke et al. 2019，R1142）。
datasets: Visuo-haptic prediction errors (EEG, motion), BIDS

classes: imagined song pitch comparison; perceived song pitch comparison
cue: visually presented words from a familiar song
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: pitch comparison between two words of a familiar song, in imagery vs perception (Zatorre et al. 1996, PET). Sibling: -002 continuation of a familiar tune in imagery after its first notes are heard (criteria 1, 2).

classes: tune continuation in imagery; listening control
cue: first notes of a familiar tune (auditory)
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 2 vs IMG-AUD-001: an auditory cue (opening notes) followed by continuation of the melody instead of visually presented lyrics with a pitch judgement.

name_zh: 指令跟随想象（意识评估）
classes: motor imagery (playing tennis); spatial imagery (navigating one's home); rest
cue: spoken instruction
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: fMRI blocks of tennis imagery and house-navigation imagery alternating with rest, instructed verbally (Owen et al. 2006). Siblings: -002 bedside EEG motor-imagery trials (criteria 1, 2, 3), -003 yes/no communication by imagery type (criterion 1).

name_zh: 床旁脑电运动想象指令跟随
classes: motor-imagery commands (two movements, to be checked against R0858); relax
cue: spoken instruction with tone cues
distinguishing: Criteria 1, 2 and 3 vs IMG-CMD-001: short EEG trials paced by tones with two motor-imagery commands, instead of 30-s fMRI blocks of tennis vs house-navigation imagery.

name_zh: 基于想象的是/否沟通（功能磁共振）
classes: yes (one imagery type); no (the other imagery type)
cue: spoken question; spoken words marking imagery and rest periods
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs IMG-CMD-001: the classes are answers (yes/no) mapped onto the two imagery types instead of instructed imagery types; the cue includes a question.

cue: visual instruction / arithmetic problem
distinguishing: Canonical configuration / 标准配置（公认）: silent calculation contrasted with a baseline task (two classes), cue-paced trials, no feedback - the configuration used by BNCI2015_004-style and fNIRS mental-arithmetic BCIs. Sibling: -002 five-class mental-task set (criterion 1). Keirn & Aunon 1990 (R0842) is the class-origin candidate only; whatever task set it contained does not change the meaning of -001 (D-062, D-063).
datasets: Colorado State Keirn & Aunon mental-task EEG data; Open Access Dataset for EEG plus NIRS Single-Trial Classification (TU Berlin hybrid EEG+NIRS, MI and MA)

name_zh: 五分类心理任务脑机接口
cue: visual cue
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs IMG-MA-001: five mental-task classes (arithmetic plus four others) instead of arithmetic vs baseline. Content (class list, relation to Keirn & Aunon 1990) to be verified in sprint 3 (D-063); the ID keeps this meaning.
datasets: BNCI2015_004 (MOABB)

classes: olfactory imagery; visual imagery of the odour source
cue: odour name
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: cued odour imagery contrasted with visual imagery (Djordjevic et al. 2005, secondary citation). No sibling protocol yet.

cue: pairs of three-dimensional block figures at different angular disparities
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: same/mirror judgement of rotated 3-D object pairs (Shepard & Metzler 1971, behavioural origin, D-031). No sibling protocol yet.

classes: attend left wrist; attend right wrist
cue: visual cue; equal vibrotactile stimulation of both wrists
stimulus_coding: bilateral simultaneous vibrotactile stimulation
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: selective attention to one of two simultaneously vibrated wrists (Yao et al. 2013). Sibling: -002 attentional orientation to a body part without stimulation (criterion 2).

name_zh: 无刺激的体感注意定向
classes: attend left hand; attend right hand
cue: visual cue (no tactile stimulus)
distinguishing: Criterion 2 vs IMG-SAO-001: attention is oriented to a body part without any vibrotactile stimulus.

classes: imagined vowels (set to be checked against R1109)
cue: visual cue
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: imagined vowel articulation classified offline from scalp EEG with common spatial patterns (DaSalla et al. 2009). Siblings: -002 imagined command words (criterion 1), -003 phoneme and word set with interleaved overt speech (criteria 1, 2).

cue: visual cue
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs IMG-SPI-001: a set of directional command words instead of vowels.
datasets: Thinking out loud, an open-access EEG-based BCI dataset for inner speech recognition

name_zh: 想象音素、音节与词（混合集合）
name_en: Imagined phonemes, syllables and words (mixed set)
classes: iy; uw; piy; tiy; diy; m; n; pat; pot; knew; gnaw
cue: visual prompt
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs IMG-SPI-001 (vowels only) and vs IMG-SPI-002 (directional command words): a mixed set of seven phonemes/syllables and four phonologically similar words.

cue: visual cue after prior experience of the real vibration
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: imagery of a previously experienced wrist vibration vs rest (Yakovlev et al. 2023). No sibling protocol yet.

classes: visual imagery of a pattern; perception of the pattern
cue: instruction to visualise a learned pattern with eyes closed
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: imagery of simple learned patterns compared with perception, PET and rTMS of area 17 (Kosslyn et al. 1999). Sibling: -002 category-specific imagery of faces vs places (criterion 1).

name_zh: 类别特异视觉想象（面孔对场景）
cue: cue naming a familiar face or place
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs IMG-VIS-001: two stimulus categories (faces vs places) contrasted with each other instead of imagery vs perception of simple patterns.

cue: letter strings generated by a finite-state grammar
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：字母串，学习后做合语法性分类（Reber 1967, R0017）。音调串版本暂记为提议。

classes: sentence with additional intonational phrase boundary; sentence without it
cue: naturally spoken sentences
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：听自然语音句子中的语调短语边界（Steinhauer et al. 1999, R1164）。与 -002（阅读，以逗号标记边界，准则 2）区别。

name_zh: 阅读中的闭合正漂移（逗号标记边界）
name_en: Closure positive shift in reading (comma-marked boundaries)
cue: written sentences presented word by word
distinguishing: 准则 2：刺激由自然语音中的语调边界（LAN-CPS-001）变为书面句子中的逗号。

classes: gesture congruent with speech; gesture incongruent with speech
cue: videos of a speaker producing speech with iconic hand gestures
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：言语—手势一致 vs 不一致视频（源头 TBD）。本类目前只有这一配置；手势—言语时间偏移为参数。

name_zh: 语言层级结构频率标记
classes: structured syllable sequence; random syllable sequence
cue: isochronous synthesised syllable sequences
stimulus_coding: frequency tagging of syllable, phrase and sentence rates
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：等时音节序列，频率标记音节/短语/句子速率（Ding et al. 2016, R1161）。本类只有这一配置。

cue: visually presented letter strings, one at a time
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：视觉词汇判断（类源头 Meyer & Schvaneveldt 1971, R0022）。听觉词汇判断暂记为提议（无线索）。

cue: visually presented sentences and nonword sequences, word by word
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：阅读句子 vs 非词序列的组块设计（Fedorenko et al. 2010, R1162）。与 -002（听完整 vs 声学退化语音，准则 2）区别。

name_zh: 听觉语言定位任务（完整 vs 退化语音）
name_en: Auditory language localizer (intact vs degraded speech)
cue: spoken passages (interview excerpts and similar)
distinguishing: 准则 2：刺激由书面句子/非词（LAN-LOC-001）变为口语段落与声学退化版本。

classes: harmonically regular chord; harmonically irregular chord
cue: chord sequences or musical phrases
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：和弦序列中的和声规则/违例目标和弦（R1030，仅标题与 PMID）。本类目前只有这一配置。

cue: sentences presented visually word by word (RSVP)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：句末语义违例 vs 一致（Kutas & Hillyard 1980, R0924）。与 -002（按完形概率分级的期待性，准则 1）区别。

name_zh: 按完形概率分级的句末词
classes: high cloze; medium cloze; low cloze
cue: sentences presented visually word by word
distinguishing: 准则 1：条件集由一致/语义违例二分（LAN-N400-001）变为同属可接受结尾、按完形概率分级的多个水平。

cue: continuous natural speech (audiobooks, stories, podcasts)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：连续自然语音聆听，TRF/刺激重建分析（R1026、R1005）。本类只有这一配置；多说话人选择性注意属 PER-AAD（包 A）。

cue: pseudowords embedded in sentence contexts, pictures or definitions
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：语境中学习新词，再测其 N400 效应（源头 TBD）。本类目前只有这一配置。

cue: visually or auditorily prompted syllables, read aloud
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：开环出声说出提示的辅音—元音音节，ECoG 记录腹侧感觉运动皮层（R0941）。与 -002（瘫痪者尝试说固定小词表、实时离散解码，准则 1;4）、-003（大词表句子、实时连续解码，准则 1;4）区别。

name_zh: 尝试言语：小词表单词实时解码
name_en: Attempted speech: small-vocabulary word decoding with real-time output
classes: word from a fixed small vocabulary (size: parameter)
cue: visually cued words and sentences
distinguishing: 准则 1;4：类别集由音节（LAN-OVS-001）变为固定小词表中的词；实时解码并显示结果（离散闭环反馈）。

name_zh: 尝试言语：大词表句子解码
classes: phoneme sequence of an open-vocabulary sentence
cue: visually cued sentences
stimulus_coding: phoneme-level decoding with a large-vocabulary language model
distinguishing: 准则 1;4：类别集由固定小词表（LAN-OVS-002）变为开放大词表的音素序列；输出在尝试说句的过程中连续更新（连续闭环反馈）。

cue: sentences presented word by word
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：句法违例（一致性或短语结构错误）vs 合法句（R1071，SPS）。与 -002（花园路径暂时歧义句，准则 1）区别。

cue: sentences presented word by word
distinguishing: 准则 1：条件集由不合语法的违例句（LAN-P600-001）变为合语法但暂时歧义、需重新分析的句子与无歧义对照。

classes: phoneme category A; phoneme category B
cue: syllables from an acoustic continuum between two (or three) phonemes
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：音位连续体上的音节辨认（R1169）。本类只有这一配置。

cue: visually presented word or letter pairs
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：押韵判断（Shaywitz et al. 1998, R0162，最早神经影像线索，非任务源头）。音位删除等其他语音意识任务暂记为提议。

cue: line drawings or photographs of objects or actions
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：出声图片命名（源头候选 R0914）。与 -002（图词干扰：叠加干扰词，准则 2）区别。

cue: picture with a superimposed written (or simultaneous spoken) distractor word
distinguishing: 准则 2（及 1）：刺激由单纯图片（LAN-PN-001）变为图片 + 干扰词，条件集按干扰词与目标名称的关系划分。

cue: visible prime word followed by a target word
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：可见启动词 + 目标词（词汇判断或阅读；Meyer & Schvaneveldt 1971, R0022）。与 -002（掩蔽启动，准则 2）区别。

cue: pattern-masked brief prime followed by a visible target
stimulus_coding: forward/backward pattern masking of the prime
distinguishing: 准则 2：启动刺激由可见（LAN-PRIME-001）变为被图形掩蔽、几乎不可见的短暂呈现。

cue: sentences or texts read freely
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：自由阅读 + EEG/眼动同步，注视锁时（Dimigen et al. 2011, R1163）。本类只有这一配置。

cue: written or spoken sentences followed by comprehension questions
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：结构复杂/暂时歧义句 vs 简单句的理解（类源头 Frazier & Rayner 1982, R0055）。与 -002（手语句子理解，准则 2，D-044）区别。

cue: videos of a signer
distinguishing: 准则 2：输入由书面/口语句子（LAN-SC-001）变为视觉—手势模态的手语句子。

name_zh: 语义判断任务（语言定位）
cue: spoken animal names (semantic task) and tone sequences (control)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：语义判断 vs 音调判断组块对比（R1168）。本类只有这一配置。

name_zh: 言语诱发抑制与听觉反馈
cue: self-produced speech sounds vs playback of the same recordings
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：说话 vs 听回放（Curio et al. 2000, R1167）。与 -002（实时改变听觉反馈，准则 1;4）区别；D-042 若并入 ERR-AAF-001，其音高扰动响应在本类下取 -003。

name_zh: 改变听觉反馈下的说话
classes: speak with normal feedback; speak with altered feedback; listen
cue: real-time manipulation of the participant's own voice
distinguishing: 准则 1;4：在说/听对比（LAN-SIS-001）中加入实时改变的听觉反馈条件，反馈路径被实时操纵（连续闭环）。

classes: structured syllable stream; random syllable stream
cue: continuous stream of synthesised syllables forming trisyllabic words by transitional probability
stimulus_coding: frequency tagging of syllable and word rates (neural versions)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：听觉音节流（Saffran et al. 1996, R1166，婴儿行为学源头）。视觉形状流版本暂记为提议。

classes: language repeat trial; language switch trial
cue: pictures or digits with a cue indicating the response language
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：线索指定语言的图片/数字命名（产出），重复 vs 切换（源头 TBD；R1211）。与 -002（接受性语言切换，准则 1;2）区别。

classes: language repeat trial; language switch trial
cue: written words in either language (language is given by the word, no cue)
distinguishing: 准则 1;2：任务由线索指定语言的命名产出（LAN-SWITCH-001）变为对两种语言词的理解判断，无语言提示线索。

cue: spoken letter or category cue
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：神经心理测验（限时口头生成，每个线索一个固定时段；Benton et al. 1983, R0061）。与 -002（BCI 心理任务：短的提示试次中默想生词 vs 休息，准则 1;3）、-003（fNIRS 组块设计，生成与控制交替，准则 1）区别。

name_zh: 默想生词心理任务（fNIRS/EEG BCI）
name_en: Covert word generation mental task (fNIRS/EEG BCI)
cue: visual letter cue per trial
distinguishing: 准则 1;3：由每线索一个计分时段的测验（LAN-VF-001）变为默想生词与休息两类的短提示试次，用作 BCI 分类；Shin 等数据集为开环（无反馈）。
datasets: Simultaneous acquisition of EEG and NIRS during cognitive tasks for an open access dataset (n-back, DSR, word generation; Shin et al.)

name_zh: 言语流畅性 fNIRS 组块设计
cue: spoken letter cues during the task period; repetition instruction during control periods
distinguishing: 准则 1：在流畅性生成（LAN-VF-001）前后加入控制期并以“任务 − 控制”对比为读出，条件集由单一生成条件变为生成与控制两类。

cue: visually or auditorily presented nouns
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：给名词生成相关动词 vs 复述/朗读（Petersen et al. 1988, R0082）。本类只有这一配置（出声/默想为参数，临床组块设计待复核）。

name_zh: 视觉词形加工（字词定位）
classes: written words; control strings (consonant strings, false fonts, objects)
cue: visually presented words and control stimuli
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：字词 vs 控制刺激（R1165）。本类只有这一配置（事件相关 vs 组块为参数，待复核）。

cue: brief whole-display memory array of simple coloured squares or features, followed by a test array
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：全视野记忆阵列 + 测试阵列，二择一报告“有/无变化”，集合大小为参数（Luck & Vogel 1997, R0151）。与 -002（连续报告，准则 1）、-003（偏侧化箭头前线索，准则 2）区别。

classes: continuous feature report of the probed item
cue: memory array, then a location probe and a continuous response scale (colour wheel or orientation)
distinguishing: 准则 1：报告空间由“有/无变化”二择（MEM-CD-001）变为对被探测项目特征的连续复现；刺激与时序同 -001。

cue: central arrow pre-cue to one hemifield, then a bilateral memory array and a test array
stimulus_coding: bilateral arrays with spatial pre-cue (contralateral minus ipsilateral subtraction)
distinguishing: 准则 2：在全视野阵列（MEM-CD-001）之外加入指向一侧视野的箭头前线索与双侧阵列，使对侧–同侧差（CDA）可测。

cue: greyscale unfamiliar face photographs; learning views then three-alternative test displays
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：标准化测验（学习 + 三择一识别，含新视角与加噪阶段；Duchaine & Nakayama 2006, R0354）。本类目前只有这一配置。

cue: serially presented single items (words or pictures) on screen
stimulus_coding: three-stimulus oddball: rare probe and rare target among frequent irrelevants, one stimulus per trial
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：三刺激（探测/无关/靶）单刺激试次序列（Farwell & Donchin 1991, R1160）。与 -002（复合试次协议 CTP，准则 3）区别。

name_zh: 复合试次协议（P300 隐匿信息测试）
cue: two sequential stimuli per trial: probe/irrelevant item, then target/non-target item
stimulus_coding: dual-stimulus trials (probe/irrelevant followed by target/non-target)
distinguishing: 准则 3（及 1）：试次结构由每试次一个刺激（MEM-CIT-001 三刺激协议）变为每试次两个刺激（先探测/无关、后靶/非靶），类别集相应改变。

cue: study item followed by an item-specific remember or forget instruction
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：逐项给出记住/遗忘指示（item method；类源头 Bjork 1970, R0021，该文的指示方式待核对）。与 -002（list method，整列表后给指示，准则 3）区别。

cue: one remember/forget instruction after the whole first list
distinguishing: 准则 3：遗忘指示由逐项给出（MEM-DF-001 item method）变为整列表后给出一次，比较单位由项目变为列表。

cue: visual sample stimulus, blank delay, single probe
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：样本—延迟—探测，判断探测是否与样本相同（类源头 Fuster & Alexander 1971, R0025，动物研究，D-031 第 2 款）。延迟非匹配（DNMS）配置无人类线索，暂记为提议。

classes: studied word; critical lure; unrelated new word
cue: auditory or visual lists of semantic associates of a non-presented critical lure
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：联想词表学习 + 回忆/再认测试（Deese 1959, R0006；Roediger & McDermott 1995, R0122）。本类只有这一配置。

cue: spoken or visually presented digit sequences of increasing length
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：顺背数字广度（Jacobs 1887, R1158）。与 -002（倒背，准则 1）区别。

cue: spoken or visually presented digit sequences
distinguishing: 准则 1：任务规则由按原顺序复述（MEM-DS-001）变为倒序复述。

classes: remember past event; imagine future event
cue: cue words prompting a specific personal event
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：线索词引发回忆过去/想象未来事件，分构建与细化两阶段（Addis et al. 2007, R0376）。本类只有这一配置。

cue: visually or auditorily presented word list, one word at a time, followed by a distractor or delay and a free-recall period
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：单次学习—自由回忆的词表（Murdock 1962, R1155）。与 -002（RAVLT：重复学习—回忆循环 + 干扰表 + 延迟回忆与再认，准则 1;3）区别。

name_zh: Rey 听觉词语学习测验
classes: learning trials 1-5; interference list B; short-delay recall; long-delay recall; recognition
cue: auditory word list read by the examiner
distinguishing: 准则 1;3：同一列表的重复学习—回忆循环 + 干扰列表 + 延迟回忆与再认，取代 MEM-FR-001 的单次学习—回忆。

name_zh: 元记忆（知晓感、学习判断）
cue: general-knowledge questions or cue words; recall attempt, then FOK rating, then recognition test
stimulus_coding: recall-judgment-recognition (RJR) procedure
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：回忆—判断—再认（RJR）知晓感程序（Hart 1965, R0013）。与 -002（学习判断 JOL：学习后预测回忆，准则 1;3）区别。

cue: word pairs at study; cue word for the JOL prompt and the recall test
stimulus_coding: study-judgment-recall procedure
distinguishing: 准则 1;3：判断对象与时序改变——学习后预测之后能否回忆（学习—判断—回忆），而不是回忆失败后预测能否再认（MEM-META-001 回忆—判断—再认）。

cue: colour photographs of everyday objects
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：显式“旧/相似/新”三择判断（类源头 Kirwan & Stark 2007, R0373；标准化 MST 见 Stark et al. 2013, R0565，连续再认与学习—测试两阶段呈现作为参数范围，待核对）。与 -002（偶然编码、无记忆判断的重复抑制设计，准则 1）区别。

name_zh: 偶然编码的记忆相似性（重复抑制设计）
cue: object photographs with an incidental indoor/outdoor judgement
distinguishing: 准则 1：条件集由显式“旧/相似/新”判断（MEM-MST-001）变为不要求记忆判断的首次/重复/诱饵对比，读出为 BOLD 重复抑制。

cue: first-person virtual town with landmarks and target locations
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：虚拟城镇中的寻路/路线导航（Maguire et al. 1998, R0164；Hartley et al. 2003, R0265）。与 -002（虚拟放射臂迷宫，准则 1;2）、-003（虚拟 Morris 水迷宫，准则 1;2）区别。

classes: baited arm; unbaited / already visited arm
cue: virtual 8-arm (or 4-on-8) maze with distal landmarks
distinguishing: 准则 1;2：环境与任务由城镇寻路（MEM-NAV-001）变为多臂迷宫中的赢—移（win-shift）觅食，类别为已访问/未访问、有/无奖励的臂；每次进入给出是否获得奖励的离散反馈（准则 4）。

classes: hidden platform; probe (no platform); visible platform (control)
cue: virtual circular arena with distal room cues
distinguishing: 准则 1;2：单一隐藏目标的开放场寻找（MEM-NAV-001 为城镇路线），含探测试次与可见平台控制；到达平台为离散反馈（准则 4）。

cue: single stream of serially presented stimuli
stimulus_coding: single-stream n-back, one fixed n per run
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：单一刺激流、固定 n 的 n-back（Kirchner 1958, R1154）。与 -002（含 0-back 控制的多负荷组块设计，准则 1;3）、-003（双通道 n-back，准则 1;2）、-004（自适应双 n-back 训练，准则 4）区别。

name_zh: 含 0-back 控制的多负荷 n-back（组块设计）
classes: 0-back; lower load n-back; higher load n-back
cue: single stimulus stream (letters, digits or locations) with a block instruction screen indicating n
distinguishing: 准则 1;3：条件集由单一固定 n（MEM-NBK-001）变为含 0-back 控制的多个负荷水平，并采用负荷组块（与休息）交替的组块设计；具体负荷水平组合（如 0/1/2/3 或 0/2/3）为参数。
datasets: Simultaneous acquisition of EEG and NIRS during cognitive tasks (Shin et al. 2018), dataset with n-back blocks

classes: visual match; auditory match; both match; no match
cue: simultaneous visual-spatial stream and auditory letter stream
stimulus_coding: two concurrent streams with independent n-back targets
distinguishing: 准则 1;2：刺激由单一流（MEM-NBK-001）变为同时呈现的视觉空间流与听觉字母流，靶类别由一类变为视觉/听觉/双重/无四类。

name_zh: 自适应双 n-back 训练
classes: visual match; auditory match; both match; no match
cue: simultaneous visual-spatial stream and auditory letter stream; level changes between blocks
stimulus_coding: two concurrent streams; performance-adaptive n
distinguishing: 准则 4（及 3）：在双通道 n-back（MEM-NBK-003）基础上按组块成绩自适应调整 n 并给出成绩反馈，构成闭环训练；以多次训练组块取代单次测试。

cue: studied and unstudied words or pictures intermixed at test
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：学习—测试，二择“旧/新”判断（类源头 Mandler 1980, R0051）。与 -002（记得/知道判断，准则 1，D-024）区别。

cue: studied and unstudied items intermixed at test
distinguishing: 准则 1：报告类别由“旧/新”二类（MEM-ON-001）变为“记得/知道/新”三类。

classes: later recalled pair; later forgotten pair
cue: word-word pairs at study; first word as cue at test
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：词—词配对学习与线索回忆（源头 TBD）。与 -002（物体—位置视空间配对联想，准则 2）区别。

cue: abstract patterns or objects in spatial locations
distinguishing: 准则 2：联想对由词—词（MEM-PA-001）变为图案/物体—位置，测试为位置指认。

cue: ongoing-task stimuli with embedded event cues (for example a target word)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：事件型前瞻记忆（Einstein & McDaniel 1990, R0092）。与 -002（时间型，以时间而非事件为线索，准则 2）区别。

classes: ongoing-task trial; clock check; PM response at target time
cue: ongoing-task stimuli; a clock that can be checked on request
distinguishing: 准则 2：前瞻记忆线索由外部事件（MEM-PM-001）变为时间（自我监控时钟），条件集相应增加“查看时钟”。

cue: memory array, then a spatial cue during the retention interval, then a probe
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：保持期空间回溯线索 vs 中性线索（Griffin & Nobre 2003, R1156）。本类目前只有这一配置。

classes: practised item (Rp+); unpractised item of practised category (Rp-); item of unpractised category (Nrp)
cue: category-exemplar word pairs; category plus word-stem cues for retrieval practice
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：学习—提取练习—最终测试三阶段（Anderson, Bjork & Bjork 1994, R1159）。本类只有这一配置。

cue: reward-value cue preceding each study item
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：每个学习项目前给出高/低奖赏提示，之后测试记忆（源头 TBD）。本类只有这一配置。

cue: words, pictures or faces in an incidental task
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：偶然任务中的首次 vs 重复呈现（源头 TBD）。本类只有这一配置。

name_zh: 近期探测任务（前摄干扰）
classes: positive probe; recent negative probe; non-recent negative probe
cue: small memory set of letters or words, then a single probe
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：Sternberg 式项目再认中加入近期负探测（源头 TBD，Monsell 1978 待核）。本类只有这一配置。

classes: probe in set; probe not in set
cue: memory set of 1 to several items, retention interval, single probe
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：Sternberg 项目再认（Sternberg 1966, R0014），集合大小为参数。本类只有这一配置。

cue: items encoded under an (often incidental) study task, followed by a later memory test
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：编码期活动按后续测试结果分类（Paller, Kutas & Mayes 1987, R1157）。本类只有这一配置。

cue: items studied in one of two contexts (location, voice or encoding task)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：两种学习情境 + 再认与来源判断（类源头 Johnson et al. 1993, R0107，为综述，weak_origin）。本类只有这一配置。

cue: trait adjectives with an encoding question
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：自我/他人/结构判断编码 + 意外记忆测试（Rogers et al. 1977, R0042）。本类只有这一配置。

cue: sequence of block locations tapped by the experimenter (or highlighted on screen)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：Corsi 方块敲击（Milner 1971, R0023；Corsi 1972, R0028），序列长度为参数。自定序空间搜索与偏侧化空间延迟反应配置暂记为提议。

name_zh: 睡眠中目标记忆再激活
cue: item-specific sounds paired with items at learning and re-presented during slow-wave sleep
stimulus_coding: item-specific auditory cues
distinguishing: 标准配置（公认）/ canonical configuration：学习时项目特异的声音线索，在慢波睡眠中重放一部分（Rudoy et al. 2009, R0443）。与 -002（整段学习情境的气味线索，准则 1;2）区别；-001 为公认的项目特异 TMR 配置而非最早发表的配置——更早的兄弟为 -002（Rasch et al. 2007, R1327），范式类源头取自 -002（D-062）。

name_zh: 睡眠中气味线索的情境再激活
cue: one learning-context odour re-presented during slow-wave sleep
stimulus_coding: single context cue for the whole learning session (not item-specific)
distinguishing: 准则 1;2：线索由项目特异的声音（MEM-TMR-001）变为整段学习情境的单一气味，比较单位由被提示/未被提示项目变为有/无气味的睡眠条件。

cue: cue word with a think or no-think instruction (colour or frame)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表）：学习线索—目标对，想/不想阶段，最终测试（Anderson & Green 2001, R0213）。本类只有这一配置。

classes: attempted foot movement; passive foot movement
cue: visual cue
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: cued attempted foot movements contrasted with passive foot movements in paraplegic participants, scalp-EEG beta changes analysed offline (R0922). Siblings: -002 attempted movements to spoken command in disorders of consciousness (criterion 2), -003 multi-class upper-limb attempts with online feedback (criteria 1, 4).

name_zh: 按口头指令尝试运动（意识障碍）
name_en: Attempted movement to spoken command (disorders of consciousness)
classes: attempted movement to command (body parts to be checked against R0894); rest
cue: spoken (auditory) instruction
distinguishing: Criterion 2 vs MOT-ATT-001: spoken commands instead of a visual cue, used to test command following (population and purpose differ; class set to be confirmed).

name_zh: 多类别尝试上肢与手部运动（脊髓损伤）
name_en: Multi-class attempted arm and hand movements (spinal cord injury)
classes: forearm supination; forearm pronation; hand open; palmar grasp; lateral grasp
cue: visual cue
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 4 vs MOT-ATT-001: five upper-limb attempt classes instead of attempted vs passive foot movement; discrete online feedback (icon on detection).
datasets: BNCI2019_001 (MOABB)

cue: auditory metronome whose rate is increased within the trial
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: rhythmic bimanual in-phase vs anti-phase movement with metronome frequency scaling (Kelso 1984). No sibling protocol in this class yet.

cue: visual target at the top or bottom edge of the screen
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: one-dimensional (vertical) cursor movement driven by mu-rhythm amplitude, continuous visual cursor feedback (Wolpaw et al. 1991). Siblings: -002 two-dimensional EEG cursor control (criterion 1), -003 intracortical point-and-click keyboard typing (criteria 1, 2).

classes: peripheral targets in two dimensions (number to be checked)
cue: visual target on the screen periphery
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs MOT-CURSOR-001: two-dimensional point-to-point movement to peripheral targets instead of one-dimensional movement to a top or bottom target.

name_zh: 皮层内点击式光标打字
cue: on-screen keyboard with target characters
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 2 vs MOT-CURSOR-001: continuous 2-D velocity plus a discrete click on an on-screen keyboard instead of 1-D movement to two targets.

cue: instruction to hold a steady contraction
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: maintained isometric contraction with simultaneous EEG/MEG and EMG for corticomuscular coherence (R1050). Feedback mode (force display or none) to be checked against the original. No sibling protocol yet.

classes: natural grasp types (set to be checked against R0888)
cue: real objects grasped after a visual cue
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: executed grasps of different natural grasp types decoded offline from ECoG (R0888). Siblings: -002 four complex hand gestures (criterion 1), -003 self-paced reach-and-grasp with scalp EEG (criteria 1, 3), -004 grasp-and-lift with load/friction changes (criteria 1, 2).

cue: visual cue (gesture picture)
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs MOT-GRASP-001: four static hand gestures (postures) instead of object-directed grasp types.

name_zh: 自定步调的自然伸手抓握（脑电）
cue: real objects on a table (no timing cue)
distinguishing: Criteria 1, 2 and 3 vs MOT-GRASP-001: palmar vs lateral grasp plus rest, real-object reach without a timing cue, self-paced trials, scalp EEG.
datasets: BNCI2020_001 (MOABB)

name_zh: 抓握–提起（负载与摩擦变化）
name_en: Grasp-and-lift with load and friction changes
classes: weight condition changes; friction condition changes
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 2 vs MOT-GRASP-001: a single grasp-and-lift action with unpredictable load and friction perturbations instead of a choice between grasp types.
datasets: WAY-EEG-GAL (grasp-and-lift EEG; Multi-channel EEG recordings during 3,936 grasp and lift trials with varying weight and friction)

classes: handwritten characters (letters and punctuation; set to be checked against R0947)
cue: visual prompt of the character or sentence to write
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: attempted handwriting by a participant with paralysis, intracortical spiking decoded into characters, decoded text shown (R0948/R0947). Sibling: -002 executed handwriting of a 10-letter set with scalp EEG and no feedback (criteria 1, 4).
datasets: Data from: High-performance brain-to-text communication via handwriting (Dryad)

name_zh: 实际书写字母（头皮脑电）
classes: a; d; e; f; j; n; o; s; t; v
cue: visual letter cue
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 4 vs MOT-HW-001: a ten-letter set written overtly by healthy participants without feedback instead of attempted writing of the full character set with decoded-text feedback.
datasets: BNCI2024_001 (MOABB)

classes: operant condition (action followed by tone); baseline condition (action or tone alone)
cue: rotating Libet clock for time judgements
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: self-timed key press followed by a tone, time judgements with a Libet clock, operant vs baseline conditions (Haggard et al. 2002). Interval-estimation versions are not yet split (no lead checked).

name_zh: Libet 意图时刻判断任务
cue: rotating clock
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: spontaneous self-paced movements with clock-position reports of intention (W) or movement (M) time (Libet et al. 1983). No sibling protocol yet.

cue: visual cue
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: cued overt unilateral hand or finger movement contrasted with rest, sensorimotor ERD/ERS (class origin R0928). Siblings: -002 individual finger movements (criterion 1), -003 walking (criteria 1, 3), -004 paced finger tapping blocks (criteria 2, 3), -005 single upper-limb multi-joint movements (criterion 1).
datasets: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset (eegmmidb), left/right fist execution runs

cue: cue to flex an individual finger (cue type to be checked)
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs MOT-ME-001: five individual-finger classes instead of a single hand/finger movement vs rest.
datasets: BCI Competition IV, dataset 4 (ECoG finger flexion)

cue: instruction to start and stop walking
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 3 vs MOT-ME-001: whole-body gait vs standing, recorded continuously rather than as cued single movements.

name_zh: 节律提示手指敲击（运动定位任务）
cue: visual or auditory pacing stimulus
distinguishing: Criteria 2 and 3 vs MOT-ME-001: a rhythmic pacing stimulus and a block design instead of a single cued movement per trial. Differs from MOT-SMS (class: timing precision relative to the beat) in that only the motor activation is analysed.

name_zh: 单侧上肢多关节运动执行（6 类动作 + 休息）
name_en: Upper-limb multi-joint movement execution (six movements + rest)
classes: elbow flexion; elbow extension; forearm supination; forearm pronation; hand open; hand close; rest
cue: visual cue on screen after beep and fixation cross
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs MOT-ME-001: six movements of one upper limb plus rest instead of a single movement vs rest. Executed counterpart of MOT-MI-003 (same session design).
datasets: Ofner2017 (MOABB; motor execution sessions)

cue: visual arrow cue
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: left- vs right-hand kinaesthetic imagery, visual cue, cue-paced trials, no feedback (Pfurtscheller & Neuper 1997). Siblings differ by class set (-002 four classes, -003 upper-limb multi-joint, -004 feet vs rest, -006 right hand vs feet, -008 three classes, -010 both hands vs both feet, -011 eleven upper-limb tasks), feedback (-005, -007) or trial structure (-009 asynchronous).
datasets: BCI Competition IV, dataset 2b (screening sessions without feedback); PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset (eegmmidb), left/right fist imagery runs; Cho2017 (MOABB; left/right hand MI)

name_zh: 四分类运动想象（左手/右手/双脚/舌头）
name_en: Four-class motor imagery (left hand / right hand / feet / tongue)
classes: left hand; right hand; feet; tongue
cue: visual arrow cue (left/right/down/up)
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs MOT-MI-001: class set changes from two (left/right hand) to four classes (left hand, right hand, feet, tongue); cue, trial structure and (absent) feedback unchanged.
datasets: BCI Competition IV, dataset 2a (BNCI2014_001)

name_zh: 单侧上肢多关节运动想象（6 类动作 + 休息）
name_en: Upper-limb multi-joint motor imagery (six movements + rest)
classes: elbow flexion; elbow extension; forearm supination; forearm pronation; hand open; hand close; rest
cue: visual cue on screen after beep and fixation cross
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs MOT-MI-001: class identity and number change from left/right hand to six movements of one upper limb plus rest. Differs from MOT-MI-011 (eleven upper-extremity tasks) by class set.
datasets: Ofner2017 (BNCI Horizon 2020 upper-limb movement data; MOABB)

name_zh: 足部运动想象脑开关（β 反弹）
name_en: Foot motor imagery brain switch (beta rebound)
cue: visual cue
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs MOT-MI-001: a single foot-imagery class against rest (detected via post-imagery beta rebound) instead of left vs right hand.
datasets: An EEG database for the cognitive assessment of motor imagery during walking with a lower-limb exoskeleton (configuration to be checked)

name_zh: 带连续视觉反馈的左/右手运动想象
name_en: Left/right-hand motor imagery with continuous visual feedback
cue: visual arrow cue
distinguishing: Criterion 4 vs MOT-MI-001: same class set and cue, but continuous online visual feedback of the classifier output (closed loop) instead of no feedback.
datasets: BCI Competition IV, dataset 2b (smiley feedback sessions; BNCI2014_004)

name_zh: 右手对双脚运动想象（提示驱动，无反馈）
name_en: Right-hand vs feet motor imagery (cue-based, no feedback)
cue: visual cue
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs MOT-MI-001: class set right hand vs feet instead of left vs right hand. Criterion 4 vs MOT-MI-007 (no feedback here).
datasets: BNCI2003_004 (MOABB; 118 channels; right hand vs feet)

name_zh: 带连续反馈的右手对双脚运动想象
name_en: Right-hand vs feet motor imagery with continuous feedback
cue: visual cue
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 4 vs MOT-MI-001 (right hand vs feet; continuous feedback). Criterion 4 vs MOT-MI-006 (same classes, feedback added).
datasets: BNCI2015_001 (cursor feedback); BNCI2014_002 (bar graph feedback)

name_zh: 三分类运动想象（左手/右手/双脚）
name_en: Three-class motor imagery (left hand / right hand / feet)
cue: visual arrow cue (left/right/down) after a beep
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs MOT-MI-001 (feet added) and vs MOT-MI-002 (tongue absent).
datasets: Zhou2016 (MOABB); Beetl2021_B (MOABB; left hand, right hand, feet)

name_zh: 异步（自定步调）运动想象（含空闲态）
name_en: Asynchronous (self-paced) motor imagery with idle state
classes: motor imagery class A (two of left hand / right hand / foot); motor imagery class B; idle state
cue: cue-based calibration; evaluation periods of varying length without trial structure
distinguishing: Criterion 3 vs MOT-MI-001: asynchronous classification of continuous EEG with an idle class instead of cue-paced trials (criterion 1 also differs: idle state added; imagery pair chosen per participant).
datasets: BCI Competition IV, dataset 1

name_zh: 双手对双脚运动想象（目标提示）
name_en: Both-hands vs both-feet motor imagery (target cue)
cue: visual target at the top or bottom of the screen
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 2 vs MOT-MI-001: bilateral hands vs feet (plus rest) instead of left vs right hand; screen-position target instead of an arrow.
datasets: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset (eegmmidb), fists/feet imagery runs

name_zh: 单侧上肢 11 类动作想象
cue: visual cue
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs MOT-MI-001 and MOT-MI-003: eleven upper-extremity tasks (class identities not yet listed from the source) instead of two hand classes or six movements + rest.
datasets: Jeong2020 multimodal dataset (25 subjects, 60-channel EEG, 7 EMG, 4 EOG, 3 sessions)

cue: figure to trace, hand seen only in a mirror
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: repeated tracing of a figure under mirror-reversed visual feedback of the hand (behavioural origin R0106, D-031). No sibling protocol yet.

name_zh: 自主运动准备（准备电位）
cue: none (self-initiated)
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: self-paced brief voluntary movements, EEG back-averaged to movement onset (Kornhuber & Deecke 1965). Siblings: -002 visually cued movements (criteria 2, 3), -003 online self-paced detection triggering peripheral stimulation (criterion 4).

name_zh: 提示驱动的运动相关皮层电位（联合式脑机接口）
cue: visual cue
distinguishing: Criteria 2 and 3 vs MOT-MRCP-001: movement timed by an external visual cue (cue-locked trials) instead of self-paced; stimulation timing is fixed by the cue, not by online detection (contrast MOT-MRCP-003).

name_zh: 自定步调在线 MRCP 检测触发外周刺激
name_en: Self-paced online MRCP detection triggering peripheral stimulation
cue: none (self-paced)
distinguishing: Criterion 4 vs MOT-MRCP-001: online detection of each self-paced MRCP triggers peripheral nerve stimulation (discrete, closed loop) instead of offline averaging; criterion 1 also differs (idle class).

name_zh: 运动序列学习（手指序列）
cue: explicit instruction of the finger sequence
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: explicitly known finger-opposition sequence practised over sessions, trained vs untrained sequence blocks (Karni et al. 1998). No sibling protocol yet; overlap with MOT-SRT pending (decisions.md).

classes: movement with mirrored visual feedback; movement without mirror feedback
cue: digital mirror display of the moving hand
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: unilateral movement viewed as a (digitally) mirrored image in place of the hidden hand (R1123; origin not established). No sibling protocol yet.

classes: action observation; static or non-biological control
cue: video or live demonstration of hand actions
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: passive observation of hand actions vs control stimuli (R0995, MEP readout; first neural recording R0845). Observation combined with imagery is not split (no lead).

name_zh: 被动运动（本体感觉刺激）
cue: none (movement imposed by experimenter or device)
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: rhythmic passive finger movements with kinematics recorded for corticokinematic coherence (Bourguignon et al. 2015). No sibling protocol yet.

cue: none (unpredictable support-surface translation or pull)
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: unpredictable whole-body balance perturbations, perturbation-evoked N1 and theta (R1122; origin not established). No sibling protocol yet.

cue: smoothly moving visual target
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: pursuit of a smoothly moving target vs fixation blocks in fMRI (Petit & Haxby 1999). No sibling protocol yet.

classes: 0 deg; 45 deg; 90 deg; 135 deg; 180 deg; 225 deg; 270 deg; 315 deg
cue: visual target light at one of eight radial positions
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: two-dimensional centre-out arm movements to eight radially arranged targets (R1020, non-human primate origin, D-031). Sibling: -002 four-direction wrist centre-out movements with MEG (criterion 1).
datasets: Neural Latents Benchmark '21 (MC_Maze etc.; non-human primate reaching; DANDI)

name_zh: 四方向腕部中心外伸运动（脑磁）
cue: visual target
distinguishing: Criterion 1 vs MOT-REACH-001: four wrist-movement directions instead of eight arm-reaching targets.
datasets: BCI Competition IV, dataset 3 (MEG, 10 channels)

cue: visual imperative stimulus mapped to a response hand
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: two-choice reaction time with left/right-hand responses, LRP (Gratton et al. 1988). A simple-RT protocol (single response) is proposed in split_log (no checked lead).

classes: visually guided saccade to a peripheral target
cue: peripheral visual target onset
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: immediate visually guided (pro)saccades from central fixation (class placeholder origin R0001, weak_origin, D-031). Sibling: -002 memory-guided saccades to a remembered location after a delay (criteria 2, 3).

cue: brief peripheral target; fixation-point dimming as go signal
distinguishing: Criteria 2 and 3 vs MOT-SACC-001: the target is absent at saccade time (memory cue and go signal) and a delay period is inserted; target reappearance gives discrete feedback for a corrective saccade.

name_zh: 感觉运动同步（节拍器敲击）
cue: auditory metronome
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: finger tapping on or between metronome beats (R1118). A synchronization-continuation protocol is proposed in split_log (no checked lead).

name_zh: 序列反应时（运动序列学习）
classes: repeating sequence block; random sequence block
cue: visual location cue mapped to keys
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: implicit repeating sequence of cue locations vs random blocks (Nissen & Bullemer 1987). No sibling protocol yet.

cue: continuously moving visual target
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: continuous following of a moving target with the hand, kinematics decoded offline (open loop). Sibling: -002 online closed-loop decoding with decoded-cursor feedback (criterion 4).
datasets: BNCI2020_002 (MOABB; snakerun/freerun/eyerun visual targets)

name_zh: 在线闭环追踪（解码光标）
cue: continuously moving visual target
distinguishing: Criterion 4 vs MOT-TRACK-001: continuous feedback of the online-decoded trajectory (closed loop) instead of offline decoding.

name_zh: 听觉选择性注意（鸡尾酒会）
cue: instruction to attend one of two concurrent, dichotically presented speech streams
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：两路同时呈现（双耳分听）的连续语音，指示注意其中一路，按刺激包络重建解码被注意者，开环。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: RSVP stream containing two targets (T1, T2) at varying lags
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：RSVP 流中两个靶，T1–T2 间隔（lag）为参数，按 T2 报告与否分类。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: brief clicks or tone bursts at high rate
stimulus_coding: 短声与短纯音、刺激率、强度为参数（variants），本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：高速率短声/短纯音，被动聆听，平均前 10 ms 响应。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

classes: acoustic change within an ongoing sound
cue: sound containing a change (frequency, intensity or vowel transition) in every trial
stimulus_coding: D-041 若并入 PER-AEP，按 D-057 在 PER-AEP 下取新序号。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：每个试次的持续声音中都含一次声学变化，无 oddball 结构。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: shape-singleton search display with an optional colour-singleton distractor
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：形状单例搜索，部分试次出现颜色单例干扰物。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

name_zh: 听觉诱发电位（纯音/短声）
cue: pure tones or clicks presented passively, ISI about 1 s or longer
stimulus_coding: ISI、强度、上升时间为参数；D-041 待例会。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：被动聆听纯音/短声，ISI ≥ 1 s，测 N1–P2。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

classes: target in quiet; target in masker
cue: target tones or speech with or without background noise / competing masker at varying SNR
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：靶声在安静与掩蔽噪声条件下呈现，信噪比为参数。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: static images of headless bodies vs objects (or faces, scrambled)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：组块呈现无头身体图像与物体图像对比（定位器）。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: visuo-tactile stroking of a seen rubber hand and the hidden real hand
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：橡胶手与真手同步/异步触刷的组块对比。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

name_zh: 双眼竞争与双稳态知觉
classes: percept A dominant; percept B dominant
cue: dissimilar images presented dichoptically, perceptual switches reported by key press
stimulus_coding: 频率标记版本拆为 PER-BR-002（准则 2）；歧义图形版本在 split_log 中提议。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：双眼分视不同图像，被试连续按键报告当前主导知觉。同类其他具体范式：PER-BR-002（区别见各自 distinguishing；维护者 sprint 2 QA 更正）。

classes: percept at f1 dominant; percept at f2 dominant
cue: dichoptic images, each flickering at its own frequency
stimulus_coding: frequency tagging of each eye's image
distinguishing: 准则 2（编码方案）：两眼图像各带频率标记，以稳态响应读出主导知觉；-001 无频率标记，以报告与 BOLD 为读出。

classes: object categories (e.g. faces, bodies, places, tools, animals)
cue: images of objects from several categories, often in rapid succession
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：多类别物体图像逐一呈现，按类别对比/解码。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: two versions of a scene alternating with a brief blank (flicker paradigm)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：两版场景以空屏间隔交替（闪烁范式），报告是否有变化。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: search displays, some configurations repeated across blocks
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：重复与新异的搜索布局在组间交替出现。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: central symbolic cue (arrow) predicting the target location (endogenous)
stimulus_coding: 外周闪光线索（外源性）拆为 PER-CUE-002（准则 2）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：中央符号（箭头）线索，有效/无效/中性三种条件（内源性线索）。同类其他具体范式：PER-CUE-002（区别见各自 distinguishing；维护者 sprint 2 QA 更正）。

name_zh: 外周（外源性）线索的 Posner 范式
cue: brief peripheral flash at one of the target locations (non-predictive)
distinguishing: 准则 2（提示类型）：外周突显线索（外源性、通常无预测性）取代 -001 的中央符号线索。

name_zh: 隐蔽空间注意（α 偏侧化）
cue: central cue directing covert attention to the left or right hemifield
stimulus_coding: 闭环 α 偏侧化 BCI 拆为 PER-CVA-002（准则 4）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：中央线索指引隐蔽注意左/右视野，测线索–靶间期 α 偏侧化，开环。同类其他具体范式：PER-CVA-002（区别见各自 distinguishing；维护者 sprint 2 QA 更正）。

name_zh: 隐蔽注意 α 偏侧化脑机接口
cue: cue or instruction to attend covertly to one hemifield
distinguishing: 准则 4（反馈方式）：单试次在线分类并反馈（闭环）；-001 为开环的线索–靶实验。

classes: faces; non-face objects or scrambled images
cue: photographs of faces vs other object categories
stimulus_coding: fMRI 组块定位器与 ERP 事件相关设计目前作为同一配置记录，待第二遍核对。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：面孔与非面孔物体图像逐一呈现的事件相关设计（ERP）。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。
datasets: A multi-subject, multi-modal human neuroimaging dataset (Wakeman & Henson faces); SPM multimodal faces dataset

cue: diffuse light flashes (goggles or through closed eyelids)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：弥散闪光刺激，被动观察。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: pairs of identical clicks about 500 ms apart, several seconds between pairs
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：成对短声（约 500 ms 间隔），比较 S2/S1 的 P50。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: brief taste pulses from a gustometer embedded in a constant rinsing flow
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：味觉仪在恒定冲洗流中给短味觉脉冲。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

classes: tones synchronous with heartbeat; tones delayed relative to heartbeat
cue: external tones triggered by the R-wave at short or long delays
stimulus_coding: 默数心跳（Schandry 计数版）拆为 PER-HBD-002（准则 2）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：心跳辨别：外部声音与心跳同步或延迟，被试判断是否同步。同类其他具体范式：PER-HBD-002（区别见各自 distinguishing；维护者 sprint 2 QA 更正）。

cue: start and stop signals only; no external stimulus during counting
distinguishing: 准则 2;3：无外部刺激的默数任务（以时段为单位的组块），取代 -001 由 R 波触发的外部刺激同步判断。

classes: aware of pattern; unaware of pattern
cue: task-irrelevant patterns during a demanding task; awareness probed by questionnaire after each phase
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：多阶段设计，每阶段后问卷判定是否察觉无关图形。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: Kanizsa-type inducers forming or not forming an illusory shape
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：Kanizsa 诱导物构成/不构成错觉图形。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: brief radiant heat pulses (CO2 or solid-state laser) on the skin
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：短激光热脉冲刺激皮肤。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

classes: local standard / global standard; local deviant / global standard; local standard / global deviant; local deviant / global deviant
cue: five-tone sequences, one sequence type frequent within each block
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：五音序列，组块内某一序列类型高频，局部 × 全局 2×2 条件。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: brief target followed by a backward mask at variable target-mask SOA
stimulus_coding: 元对比掩蔽在 split_log 中提议，暂无专门线索。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：后向掩蔽，靶–掩蔽 SOA 围绕阈限变化，按看见/未看见分类。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: clicks or tone bursts at moderate rate
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：中等速率短声/短纯音，分析 10–80 ms。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: tone sequence with infrequent deviants in one physical feature, sounds ignored
stimulus_coding: 语音对比 MMN 拆为 PER-MMN-002（准则 2），多特征范式拆为 PER-MMN-003（准则 1）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：被动 oddball：纯音序列中单一物理特征的低频偏差，被试忽略声音。同类其他具体范式：PER-MMN-002、PER-MMN-003（区别见各自 distinguishing；维护者 sprint 2 QA 更正）。

name_zh: 语音（音位对比）失匹配负波
classes: standard speech sound; deviant speech sound
cue: syllables or vowels as standards and deviants, sounds ignored
distinguishing: 准则 2（刺激类型）：语音音节/元音取代 -001 的纯音。

name_zh: 多特征失匹配负波范式（Optimum-1）
classes: standard; frequency deviant; intensity deviant; duration deviant; location deviant; gap deviant
cue: one tone sequence with five deviant types, standards and deviants alternating
stimulus_coding: standard-deviant alternation, five deviant types in one sequence
distinguishing: 准则 1（条件集）：一个序列内 5 种偏差类型，取代 -001 的单一偏差类型。

cue: identical moving objects, a subset briefly highlighted as targets
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：若干相同物体运动，追踪事先高亮的靶子，负荷水平为条件。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

classes: congruent audiovisual speech; incongruent audiovisual speech (McGurk); auditory-only speech
cue: audiovisual syllables with congruent or incongruent lip movements
stimulus_coding: 简单刺激（纯音 + 闪光）的加性模型配置拆为 PER-MSI-002（准则 1;2）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：视听音节，口型与语音一致或不一致（McGurk）。同类其他具体范式：PER-MSI-002（区别见各自 distinguishing；维护者 sprint 2 QA 更正）。

name_zh: 简单刺激的视听交互（加性模型）
name_en: Audiovisual interaction with simple stimuli (additive model)
cue: tones, flashes and their combination in random order
distinguishing: 准则 1;2：条件集为 A、V、AV（加性模型），刺激为非言语简单刺激；-001 为一致/不一致视听语音。

name_zh: 运动起始视觉诱发电位
cue: brief onset of visual motion with low contrast / luminance change
stimulus_coding: 多目标 mVEP BCI 拆为 PER-MVEP-002（准则 1;4）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：短暂运动起始刺激，被动观察（临床视觉检查）。同类其他具体范式：PER-MVEP-002（区别见各自 distinguishing；维护者 sprint 2 QA 更正）。

name_zh: 运动起始 VEP 脑机接口（多目标）
cue: targets each with a moving element, motion onsets in random order
stimulus_coding: time-multiplexed motion onsets per target
distinguishing: 准则 1;4：类别为屏幕目标（多选一），逐次离散选择反馈；-001 为单一运动起始、被动观察。

cue: free viewing of a continuous feature film without task
stimulus_coding: 静态自然图像观看在 split_log 中提议。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：自由观看连续影片，无任务，计算被试间相关。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

classes: attend global level; attend local level
cue: hierarchical letters (large letter made of small letters), congruent or incongruent
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：层级字母刺激，分别判断整体或局部层级。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: sequence of frequent standards and infrequent targets (auditory or visual), targets counted or responded to
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：两刺激 oddball：高频标准刺激与低频靶刺激，被试计数或按键。同类其他具体范式：三刺激 -002（准则 1）；行/列拼写器 -003、RSVP -004、RSVP 拼写 -005、棋盘格 -006、单项闪烁 -007、听觉空间 -008、触觉 -009（维护者 sprint 2 QA：原写在 stimulus_coding 中的兄弟列表移到此处；两刺激 oddball 无编码方案，删去 stimulus_coding）。

cue: stimulus sequence with frequent standards, infrequent targets and infrequent non-target distractors
distinguishing: 准则 1（条件集）：比 PER-ODD-001 多一个低频非靶干扰/新异刺激条件，用于分离 P3a 与 P3b。

cue: character matrix with random row and column flashes
stimulus_coding: row/column flashing
distinguishing: 准则 1;2;4：类别集为矩阵中的字符（选择任务而非二类计数），刺激编码为行/列闪烁，逐字符离散反馈；-001 为两刺激开环计数。
datasets: BNCI2014-008 (ALS patients, P300 speller)

cue: rapid serial visual presentation of images at one location
distinguishing: 准则 2;3：刺激为同一位置的高速图像流（RSVP），以连续流而非离散试次呈现；与 -001 同为二类开环检测。
datasets: EEG Study data of Rapid Serial Visual Presentation (RSVP) in ESS format (NITRC)

name_zh: RSVP 拼写器（不依赖注视）
classes: letters and symbols of the alphabet
cue: rapid serial presentation of letters at fixation
stimulus_coding: rapid serial presentation of symbols at one location
distinguishing: 准则 1;4（相对 -004）：类别集为字母表（选择任务），逐字母离散反馈；准则 2（相对 -003）：中央 RSVP 而非矩阵行/列闪烁。
datasets: BNCI2015-010 RSVP speller

name_zh: P300 拼写器（棋盘格范式）
cue: character matrix with flash groups drawn from a virtual checkerboard
stimulus_coding: checkerboard flashing (rows/columns of two 6 x 6 sub-matrices)
distinguishing: 准则 2（编码方案）：棋盘格分组闪烁，取代 -003 的物理行/列闪烁。矩阵规模（原始版本 8×9 共 72 项）为同质目标的参数，不构成准则 1（D-058）。

name_zh: 单项闪烁 P300 界面（六幅图像）
classes: television; telephone; lamp; door; window; radio
cue: six images each flashed individually in random order
stimulus_coding: single-item flashing
distinguishing: 准则 1;2（相对 -003）：6 个图像指令而非字符矩阵，每次只闪烁单个项目而非整行/整列。
datasets: EPFL P300 dataset (5 disabled, 4 able-bodied subjects)

name_zh: 听觉空间 P300 脑机接口（AMUSE）
classes: loudspeaker directions (e.g. 8 positions at 45 degree spacing)
cue: short band-pass noise bursts from loudspeakers around the head
stimulus_coding: spatial direction of sound source
distinguishing: 准则 2（刺激类型）：听觉空间方向编码取代 -003 的视觉矩阵闪烁。类别为扬声器方向（同质目标），扬声器个数为参数，不构成准则 1（D-058）。
datasets: BNCI2015-009 AMUSE

name_zh: 触觉 P300 脑机接口
classes: tactor locations (2, 4 or 6 around the waist in the original)
cue: vibrotactile stimuli delivered by tactors at different body sites
stimulus_coding: location of vibrotactile stimulus
distinguishing: 准则 2（刺激类型）：振动触觉刺激取代视觉/听觉刺激。类别为振动器位置（同质目标），振动器个数（2/4/6 个）为参数，不构成准则 1（D-058）。

cue: odour pulses embedded in a constant warm humidified air stream (olfactometer)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：嗅觉仪在恒定气流中给短气味脉冲。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: regular, externally timed sound sequence with occasional omissions
stimulus_coding: 自发按键产生声音的遗漏版本拆为 PER-OMIT-002（准则 2;3）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：外部定时的规则声音序列中偶尔遗漏刺激。同类其他具体范式：PER-OMIT-002（区别见各自 distinguishing；维护者 sprint 2 QA 更正）。

name_zh: 自发产生声音的遗漏范式
classes: sound after press; omission after press
cue: self-paced button presses that trigger sounds; occasional omissions
distinguishing: 准则 2;3：声音由被试自己的按键触发（运动–听觉耦合），按键自定步调；-001 为外部定时的序列。

name_zh: 失谐谐波与同时声音分离
cue: harmonic complex tones with one harmonic in tune or mistuned
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：谐波复合音中某一谐波失谐或不失谐。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: black-and-white checkerboard reversing at a fixed rate, central fixation
stimulus_coding: 翻转率、方格大小为参数。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：黑白棋盘格以固定速率翻转，注视中心。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。
