cue: rotating wedges and expanding rings sweeping the visual field
stimulus_coding: phase-encoded (travelling wave)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：旋转楔形与扩张环，相位编码（行波）设计。群体感受野（pRF）模型配置拆为 PER-RET-002（准则 2）。

cue: aperture sequences (moving bars, rings, wedges) with blank periods
stimulus_coding: model-based aperture sequence (pRF)
distinguishing: 准则 2（编码方案）：基于模型拟合的孔径序列（含空白期），取代 -001 的相位编码行波；输出包含感受野大小。

cue: brief airway occlusion at inspiration onset through a mouthpiece
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：吸气起始时经口器短暂阻断气道。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: symmetrical vs random dot or polygon patterns, about 1 s or longer
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：对称与随机点阵/多边形图案对比。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: alternating ABA- tone sequences with deviants defined within one stream; frequency separation and rate varied
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：ABA- 交替音序列，频率间隔/速率决定是否分流，流内偏差诱发 MMN。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: tactile stimuli to left and right hands, attend one side to detect infrequent targets
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：左右手触觉刺激，注意一侧检测低频靶。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: tones or narrow-band sounds in progressions of frequency
stimulus_coding: phase-encoded frequency progression
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：纯音/窄带声按频率递进呈现。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: frequent standard and rare deviant visual stimuli while performing an unrelated task
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：视觉 oddball，被试执行无关任务。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

name_zh: 嗓音知觉（颞叶嗓音区定位）
cue: blocks of vocal sounds vs non-vocal environmental sounds
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：嗓音与非嗓音环境声的组块对比（定位器）。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。
datasets: Human Voice Areas (Edinburgh Imaging image databank)

cue: display of a target among distractors, defined by one feature or a conjunction
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：特征搜索与联合搜索，靶有/无，集合大小为参数。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

name_zh: 几何图形动画心智化（Frith-Happé 动画）
classes: theory-of-mind animations; goal-directed animations; random-movement animations
cue: animations of moving geometric shapes, described or classified by the participant
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): Frith-Happé animations in three categories (Castelli et al. 2000, R1189).

classes: intact point-light action; scrambled point-light control
cue: point-light displays of human actions
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): point-light biological motion versus scrambled control (display method of Johansson 1973, R0029).

classes: group rating agrees with own rating; group rating conflicts with own rating
cue: face attractiveness rating followed by display of the group rating, then later re-rating
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): rate-feedback-rerate conformity design with per-trial group feedback (Klucharev et al. 2009, R1187).

cue: virtual ball-tossing game with two ostensible co-players
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): Cyberball inclusion followed by exclusion (Williams, Cheung & Choi 2000, sprint-2 F06).

classes: dictator allocation between self and a passive recipient
cue: endowment and recipient display; dictator chooses an allocation
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): dictator game with a passive anonymous recipient (Forsythe et al. 1994, R0114). Differs from SOC-DICT-002 (donation decisions to real charities).

classes: voluntary donation to a charity; monetary reward to self; mandatory transfer to a charity
cue: charity name or logo with the proposed amounts
distinguishing: Criterion 1 versus SOC-DICT-001: the recipient is a real charity and trials contrast voluntary giving with self-reward or mandatory transfer, rather than a single allocation to a passive person (Moll et al. 2006, R0341; Harbaugh et al. 2007, R0371).

classes: live eye-to-eye contact; gaze at eyes in a photograph
cue: live partner seated face to face, alternating with a picture
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): live eye contact versus photograph with dual-brain fNIRS (Hirsch et al. 2017, R1191).

classes: target at gazed-at location; target at non-gazed location
cue: central face with a non-predictive gaze shift, then a peripheral target
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): non-predictive gaze cueing (lead R1059). Differs from SOC-GAZE-002 (gaze-contingent interactive joint attention).

name_zh: 注视联动的交互式共同注意
classes: self-initiated joint attention; other-initiated joint attention; non-joint-attention control
cue: virtual character whose gaze responds in real time to the participant's eye movements
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 4 versus SOC-GAZE-001: initiating versus responding joint-attention conditions, and the partner's gaze is contingent on the participant's own gaze (closed loop) instead of a pre-programmed cue (leads R0986, R0966).

classes: compatible key pairing blocks; incompatible key pairing blocks
cue: words or pictures of two concepts and two attributes sorted with two keys
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): standard IAT block sequence (Greenwald et al. 1998, R0165).

classes: congruent observed finger movement; incongruent observed finger movement
cue: video of a hand performing a finger movement while the participant executes a cued movement
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): finger-movement imitation-inhibition task (Brass et al. 2000, R0188).

classes: partners see each other's movements; vision of partner blocked
cue: partner's finger movements visible or occluded
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): dyadic rhythmic finger movements with and without vision of the partner (Kelso et al., phi complex, R1172).

classes: moral-personal dilemmas; moral-impersonal dilemmas; non-moral dilemmas
cue: written dilemmas with appropriateness judgement
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): personal versus impersonal versus non-moral dilemmas (Greene et al. 2001, R1186).

cue: spoken (or visual) first names, own name presented infrequently
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): passive own-name oddball (Berlad & Pratt 1995, R1185). Differs from SOC-NAME-002 (instructed counting of own or other target name).

name_zh: 主动计数自身名字范式
classes: count own name; count another target name; passive listening
cue: spoken name sequences with an instruction before each block
distinguishing: Criterion 1 versus SOC-NAME-001: instruction conditions (count own name, count other name, passive) are added, so the contrast is voluntary attention to a name rather than self-relevance alone (Schnakers et al. 2009).

classes: painful stimulation to self; non-painful stimulation to self; painful stimulation to partner; non-painful stimulation to partner
cue: symbolic visual cues indicating who receives painful or non-painful stimulation, with the partner present
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): cue-based self/other pain paradigm with a present partner (lead R0920). Differs from SOC-PAIN-002 (pictures of body parts in painful situations).

classes: painful situation pictures; non-painful situation pictures
cue: photographs of hands or feet in everyday situations
distinguishing: Criterion 2 versus SOC-PAIN-001: pictures of body parts in painful situations instead of symbolic cues signalling pain to a present partner (leads S2-10, R0919).

name_zh: 种族与群体身份面孔分类
cue: face photographs varying in race and gender, categorised by race, gender or another feature
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): race and gender face categorisation with ERPs (Ito & Urland 2003, R1190).

name_en: Reading the mind in the eyes
classes: mental-state judgement; control judgement (age or gender)
cue: photographs of the eye region with four response words
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): revised Eyes test with a control judgement (Baron-Cohen et al. 2001, R0214).

classes: own face; familiar face; unfamiliar face
cue: face photographs (optionally self-other morphs)
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): self versus familiar versus unfamiliar face recognition; origin publication TBD (D-031).

name_zh: 社会评价反馈（社会判断范式）
classes: expected acceptance; unexpected acceptance; expected rejection; unexpected rejection
cue: peer photograph with the participant's expectation, followed by acceptance or rejection feedback
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): social judgment paradigm with expectancy-crossed feedback (Somerville et al. 2006, R1188).

classes: false-belief question; reality or memory control question
cue: acted-out or narrated story with a location change unseen by the protagonist
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): unexpected-transfer false-belief story with control questions (Wimmer & Perner 1983, R0060). Differs from SOC-TOM-002 (fMRI localizer contrasting false-belief and false-photograph stories).

name_zh: 错误信念－错误照片定位任务
cue: written stories followed by a true/false question
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 3 versus SOC-TOM-001: the control condition is a matched false-photograph story rather than reality questions, presented as a blocked fMRI localizer (Saxe & Kanwisher 2003, R0260).

classes: fair allocation observed; unfair allocation observed
cue: allocation decision between two other players, then the third party's punishment decision
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): third-party punishment of a dictator (behavioural origin, R1174).

classes: investor transfer decision; trustee return decision
cue: endowment display; the transfer is multiplied before the trustee decides
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): one-shot investment game between anonymous partners (Berg, Dickhaut & McCabe 1995, R0127). Differs from SOC-TRUST-002 (iterated prisoner's dilemma) and SOC-TRUST-003 (multi-round trust game with a fixed partner).

cue: payoff matrix display; simultaneous choices, then both choices revealed
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 3 versus SOC-TRUST-001: symmetric simultaneous cooperate/defect choices over repeated rounds instead of a sequential one-shot investment (Rilling et al. 2002, R0217).

name_zh: 固定搭档多轮信任博弈
name_en: Multi-round trust game with a fixed partner
classes: investor transfer decision; trustee return decision
cue: endowment display; partner's previous decision revealed before each new round
distinguishing: Criterion 3 versus SOC-TRUST-001: repeated rounds with the same partner, so that trial outcomes depend on the interaction history (King-Casas et al. 2005, R0312). Dual-brain recording is not itself a numbering criterion (D-021).

cue: proposer's offer displayed to the responder, who accepts or rejects
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): single-round responder decisions (Guth et al. 1982, R0054).

cue: scene with an agent; judgement of what is visible or how the scene looks from a viewpoint
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): self versus other visuospatial perspective judgements; origin publication TBD (first_source holds an fMRI study, D-031).

cue: brief Black or White face prime followed by a gun or tool picture under a response deadline
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): weapons identification task (Payne 2001, R0212).

cue: click trains or amplitude-modulated tones at a constant rate (about 40 Hz)
stimulus_coding: ASSR 听觉 BCI 拆为 SSR-ASSR-002（准则 1;2;4）；80–100 Hz 载频为参数。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：约 40 Hz 短声串/调幅音，被动聆听。同类其他具体范式：SSR-ASSR-002（区别见各自 distinguishing；维护者 sprint 2 QA 更正）。

name_zh: 基于 ASSR 的听觉脑机接口（选择性注意两路声流）
name_en: ASSR-based auditory BCI (selective attention to two streams)
classes: attend left stream; attend right stream
cue: two concurrent tone-burst trains from left and right loudspeakers at different rates
stimulus_coding: frequency tagging of two concurrent auditory streams
distinguishing: 准则 1;2;4：两路并存、不同速率的声流，条件为注意哪一路，在线离散反馈；-001 为单一声流被动聆听。

classes: beat (no imagery); imagined binary meter; imagined ternary meter
cue: repeated rhythmic sound pattern, with or without imagined meter
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：聆听节律声音，有/无想象节拍（二拍/三拍）。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

name_zh: 编码调制视觉诱发电位
classes: targets coded by circular shifts of one m-sequence
cue: targets flickering by time-shifted versions of one binary m-sequence
stimulus_coding: circularly shifted m-sequence
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：各目标使用同一 m 序列的循环移位编码，模板匹配，逐次选择反馈。Gold 码拆为 -002（准则 2），burst 码拆为 -003（准则 2）。
datasets: Castillos c-VEP dataset, m-sequence, 100 % amplitude (4 targets)

name_zh: 调制 Gold 码 c-VEP 拼写器
name_en: c-VEP speller with modulated Gold codes
cue: speller matrix, each cell flickering with its own modulated Gold code
stimulus_coding: modulated Gold codes
distinguishing: 准则 2（编码方案）：各目标使用不同的调制 Gold 码（非同一序列的循环移位），以重卷积模型生成模板；-001 为 m 序列循环移位。
datasets: Thielen 2015 c-VEP speller dataset

cue: four targets flickering with burst code sequences
stimulus_coding: burst codes
distinguishing: 准则 2（编码方案）：稀疏突发码取代 -001 的 m 序列循环移位与 -002 的 Gold 码。幅度深度（100%/40%）为参数。
datasets: Castillos burst c-VEP dataset, 100 % amplitude; Castillos burst c-VEP dataset, 40 % amplitude

cue: low-frequency tones repeated many times
stimulus_coding: 语音音节 FFR（cABR）拆为 SSR-FFR-002（准则 2）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：低频纯音重复呈现，平均锁相响应。同类其他具体范式：SSR-FFR-002（区别见各自 distinguishing；维护者 sprint 2 QA 更正）。

name_zh: 语音诱发 FFR（复杂声听觉脑干反应）
cue: repeated consonant-vowel syllable or other complex sound
distinguishing: 准则 2（刺激类型）：语音音节/复杂声取代 -001 的纯音，分析起始响应与基频/谐波跟随。

cue: sounds at a fast fixed rate with target-category sounds at a slower periodic rate
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：快速固定速率声音序列中按较慢周期插入目标类别声音。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

name_zh: 快速周期视觉刺激（频率标记）
cue: images at a fast fixed rate (e.g. 6 Hz) with oddball images at a slower periodic rate
stimulus_coding: 面孔类别 vs 面孔身份等条件集在 split_log 中提议。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：快速固定速率图像序列中按较慢周期插入 oddball 图像。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: two stimulus parts (e.g. face halves) flickering at f1 and f2
stimulus_coding: frequency tagging of parts (f1, f2), intermodulation readout
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：刺激两部分以 f1、f2 闪烁，比较对齐与错位。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: rapid periodic thermal (laser) stimulation of the skin (e.g. 7 Hz)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：皮肤快速周期性激光热刺激。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

name_zh: 节律性视觉刺激（α 夹带）
classes: target in phase with entrainer; target out of phase
cue: rhythmic visual stream near alpha frequency followed by a near-threshold target
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：近 α 频率的节律视觉流后呈现近阈靶，靶相位为条件。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

name_zh: 稳态运动视觉诱发电位
cue: oscillating Newton's rings (periodic motion, little luminance change)
stimulus_coding: frequency coding (periodic motion)
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：牛顿环周期性收缩–扩张运动，各目标不同运动频率。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

cue: vibrotactile stimulation at a constant frequency (typically 20-30 Hz) to a finger or wrist
stimulus_coding: 双侧注意 BCI 拆为 SSR-SSSEP-002（准则 1;2）。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：单一部位恒定频率振动刺激，被动。同类其他具体范式：SSR-SSSEP-002（区别见各自 distinguishing；维护者 sprint 2 QA 更正）。

name_zh: 稳态触觉空间注意脑机接口
cue: simultaneous bilateral vibration at two distinct frequencies; cue to attend one side
stimulus_coding: frequency tagging of left and right stimulation sites
distinguishing: 准则 1;2：双侧并存、不同频率的振动刺激，条件为注意左/右；-001 为单一部位被动刺激。

name_zh: 稳态视觉诱发电位范式
cue: single sinusoidally or square-wave modulated light, passive viewing
stimulus_coding: single-frequency modulation
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：单一调制光源，按运行改变频率，被动观察，开环（Regan 1966）。多目标频率编码 BCI -002（准则 1;4）、临床光驱动 -003（准则 1;3）、多刺激频率标记注意 -004（准则 1;2）、JFPM 拼写 -005（40 目标标准配置，12 目标为其变体；原 -006 已按 D-058 作废）、含静息类 -007、异步 -008。

name_zh: 频率编码多目标 SSVEP 脑机接口
cue: several targets flickering simultaneously at distinct frequencies
stimulus_coding: frequency coding
distinguishing: 准则 1;4：多个同时闪烁的目标（多选一）并逐次离散选择反馈；-001 为单一光源被动观察。准则 2（相对 -005）：仅频率编码，不编码相位。

name_zh: 光驱动（临床间断闪光刺激）
classes: stepped series of flash frequencies; eyes open / eyes closed
cue: stroboscopic flash trains in a fixed sequence of frequencies
stimulus_coding: stepped flash frequency series
distinguishing: 准则 1;3：按频率阶梯的闪光串组块（睁/闭眼）构成条件集，组块式呈现，用于临床判读；-001 为单一调制光的研究性记录。

name_zh: 并存刺激的频率标记注意
classes: attend stimulus at f1; attend stimulus at f2
cue: concurrent stimuli in separate locations, each flickering at its own frequency; cue to attend one
stimulus_coding: frequency tagging of concurrent stimuli
distinguishing: 准则 1;2：多个并存刺激各带频率标记，条件为注意哪一个（隐蔽注意，注视中央）；与 -002 区别在于开环、无选择反馈且不注视目标（准则 4）。

name_zh: 联合频率–相位调制 40 目标 SSVEP 拼写器
cue: virtual keyboard of 40 simultaneously flickering characters
stimulus_coding: joint frequency-phase modulation (JFPM)
distinguishing: 准则 2（编码方案）：联合频率–相位编码，取代 -002 的纯频率编码。目标个数（标准配置 40 字符；12 目标布局见 variants）为同质目标的参数，不构成准则 1（D-058）。
datasets: Tsinghua SSVEP benchmark dataset (Wang et al. 2016); BETA: A Large Benchmark Database Toward SSVEP-BCI Application; Tsinghua 40-target SSVEP Benchmark (TorchEEG TSUBenckmarkDataset loader); Nakanishi 2015 12-class SSVEP dataset (12-target JFPM variant)

name_zh: 联合频率–相位调制 12 目标 SSVEP
cue: 12 simultaneously flickering targets
stimulus_coding: joint frequency-phase modulation (JFPM)
distinguishing: 准则 1（相对 -005）：12 目标而非 40 字符键盘；准则 2（相对 -002）：联合频率–相位编码。公开数据为离线记录（反馈未在数据集页面说明）。
datasets: Nakanishi 2015 12-class SSVEP dataset

name_zh: 含静息（非控制）类的频率编码 SSVEP
name_en: Frequency-coded SSVEP with a no-control (rest) class
cue: three flickering LEDs; auditory instruction of the target or rest
stimulus_coding: frequency coding
distinguishing: 准则 1（条件集）：在频率类之外加入明确的静息/非控制类；与 -008 不同，试次仍由提示驱动（同步）。
datasets: Kalunga 2016 SSVEP dataset (3 frequencies + rest)

name_zh: 异步（自定步调）SSVEP 脑机接口
classes: idle state; one control class per target frequency
cue: continuously flickering frequency-coded targets, no trial cue
stimulus_coding: frequency coding
distinguishing: 准则 3（试次结构）：异步、自定步调，需检测空闲/控制状态；-002、-007 为提示驱动的同步试次。

cue: pattern reversing at a fixed rate swept through spatial frequencies within one trial
stimulus_coding: 对比度扫描在 split_log 中提议。
distinguishing: 标准配置（最早发表，即 first_source）：固定翻转率的图形在单试次内扫描空间频率。本类暂无其他具体范式（no sibling protocol yet）。

classes: responsive (awake); loss of responsiveness; return of responsiveness
cue: anaesthetic administration with periodic auditory or verbal responsiveness probes
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): anaesthetic induction and emergence with responsiveness probes; origin of the experimental protocol TBD (first_source is the bispectral analysis method, R0111).

name_zh: 睡眠慢振荡闭环听觉刺激
name_en: Closed-loop auditory stimulation of sleep slow oscillations
classes: stimulation night (sounds phase-locked to slow-oscillation up-states); sham night (no sounds)
cue: brief pink-noise bursts triggered by online detection of slow-oscillation up-states
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): closed-loop in-phase auditory stimulation versus sham (Ngo et al. 2013, R1192). feedback=discrete records the closed loop: each sound is triggered by the ongoing EEG; the sleeping participant receives no feedback display.

name_zh: 系列唤醒梦境报告范式
classes: experience reported; experience without recall; no experience
cue: awakening sound followed by a structured experience interview
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): serial awakening paradigm (Siclari et al. 2017, R1193).

classes: alert (short response time); drowsy (long response time)
cue: random lane-departure events in a driving simulator, corrected by steering
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): event-related lane-departure task where response time to each deviation labels drowsiness (Lin et al. 2005, R1176). Differs from STA-DRV-002 (continuous driving with an eye-tracking vigilance label).
datasets: Multi-channel EEG recordings during a sustained-attention driving task (figshare)

name_zh: 连续模拟驾驶（眼动警觉标注）
name_en: Continuous simulated driving with eye-tracking vigilance labels
cue: virtual driving scene; no imposed events
distinguishing: Criteria 2 and 3 versus STA-DRV-001: no lane-departure events, and vigilance is labelled continuously from eye tracking rather than from response times to discrete events (SEED-VIG dataset).
datasets: SEED-VIG

name_zh: 自然视频与学习中的投入度
name_en: Engagement during naturalistic video and learning
cue: film clips or instructional videos watched by several participants
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): inter-subject correlation of EEG during repeated or scrambled film viewing (Dmochowski et al. 2012, R1178).

cue: recorded standardised hypnotic induction
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): induction versus rest and control conditions in high and low hypnotizables; origin publication TBD (first_source holds an fMRI study, D-031).

cue: simultaneous monitoring, tracking, resource-management and communication subtasks
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): MATB with workload set by subtask rate and number (R1064/R0849); the number of workload levels is a parameter.
datasets: COG-BCI database (Zenodo)

cue: verbal instruction; eyes closed or open depending on tradition
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): meditation blocks versus baseline; meditation style (focused attention, open monitoring) is kept as a parameter for now (split_log).

cue: thought probes at unpredictable times during a monotonous task
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): experimenter-initiated thought probes (probe-caught; Antrobus et al. 1970, R0020). Differs from STA-MW-002 (participant-initiated self-caught reports).

cue: ongoing task (e.g. text reading); participant-initiated key press
distinguishing: Criterion 3 versus STA-MW-001: reports are initiated by the participant whenever they notice mind wandering (self-paced), instead of being elicited by experimenter-timed probes.

name_zh: 脑电频段功率神经反馈
classes: target EEG band-power change (e.g. SMR increase)
cue: visual or auditory display or reward signal driven by the online band power
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): operant training of one EEG frequency band with continuous feedback over sessions (earliest seen: Sterman & Friar 1972, SMR). Differs from STA-NF-002 (haemodynamic regional neurofeedback in regulate/rest blocks).

name_zh: 血流动力学区域神经反馈（rtfMRI／fNIRS）
cue: feedback display (e.g. thermometer) updated each volume, with block instructions
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 3 versus STA-NF-001: a regional haemodynamic signal is trained in alternating regulate and rest blocks, instead of continuous training of an EEG frequency band (Weiskopf et al. 2003).

cue: drug administration followed by resting-state recording
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): within-subject drug versus placebo resting recording; origin publication TBD (first_source holds a neural study, D-031).

cue: millisecond counter appearing at random intervals; the reaction time is displayed
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): 10-minute visual PVT with response-time display after each response (Dinges & Powell 1985, R0070).

classes: rest (one eye condition held for the whole run)
cue: no task; eyes closed, or eyes open on a fixation cross
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): one continuous rest run without a task (Biswal et al. 1995, R0124). Differs from STA-REST-002 (alternating eyes-closed and eyes-open blocks).
datasets: A resting-state EEG dataset for sleep deprivation

cue: verbal or auditory instruction to open or close the eyes
distinguishing: Criteria 1 and 3 versus STA-REST-001: two eye conditions alternate in blocks within a run, so eyes-closed and eyes-open rest are contrasted (Barry et al. 2007, R0362).
datasets: MPI LEMON: A mind-brain-body dataset of MRI, EEG, cognition, emotion, and peripheral physiology in young and old adults

name_zh: 慢皮层电位自我调节训练（二分类）
cue: trial-wise visual cue indicating the required polarity; the SCP is shown as a moving cursor or object
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): binary negativity/positivity training with continuous visual SCP feedback, no spelling; the configuration from which the speller (STA-SCP-002) was built.

name_zh: 慢皮层电位拼写装置（思维翻译装置）
classes: select letter group (negativity); reject letter group (positivity)
cue: letter groups presented on screen in a binary selection tree
distinguishing: Criterion 1 versus STA-SCP-001: the two SCP classes are mapped to selecting or rejecting letter groups in a binary spelling tree, so trials yield character selections (Birbaumer et al. 1999, R1177).

name_zh: 睡眠分期（Rechtschaffen & Kales 规则）
classes: wake; stage 1; stage 2; stage 3; stage 4; REM
cue: none (overnight polysomnography)
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published or canonical; D-057 -001): 30-s epochs scored into six R&K stages (Rechtschaffen & Kales 1968, R1180). Differs from STA-SLP-002 (AASM five-stage scheme).
datasets: Sleep-EDF Database Expanded (PhysioNet)

cue: none (overnight polysomnography)
distinguishing: Criterion 1 versus STA-SLP-001: five AASM classes (stages 3 and 4 merged into N3; REM renamed R) instead of six R&K stages (Iber et al. 2007).

name_zh: 自适应（闭环）深部脑刺激
classes: adaptive (beta-triggered) stimulation; comparison stimulation (conventional or none)
cue: none
stimulus_coding: stimulation switched on when subthalamic beta power exceeds a threshold
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: closed-loop on/off DBS triggered by subthalamic beta power (R1128; origin not established). No sibling protocol yet; continuously amplitude-scaled versions are proposed in split_log only if a lead is found.

classes: single-pulse stimulation of an electrode pair
cue: none
stimulus_coding: repeated single electrical pulses, responses averaged
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: repeated single-pulse stimulation of one contact pair with averaging at all other contacts (Matsumoto et al. 2004). No sibling protocol yet.

classes: DBS bursts or single pulses through the implanted lead
cue: none
stimulus_coding: short bursts or single pulses
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: stimulation through the DBS lead with recording from non-stimulating contacts (ERNA; Sinclair et al. 2018). No sibling protocol yet.

classes: galvanic vestibular stimulation; sham / cutaneous control
cue: none
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: binaural mastoid GVS vs control stimulation in fMRI blocks (Bense et al. 2001). No sibling protocol yet.

classes: median-nerve stimulation paired with motor-cortex TMS
cue: none
stimulus_coding: peripheral pulse and TMS pulse at a fixed interstimulus interval
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: repeated fixed-interval pairing, excitability measured before and after the intervention (Stefan et al. 2000, MEP origin, D-031). No sibling protocol yet.

name_zh: 经颅光生物调节同步脑电
cue: none
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: near-infrared light over the forehead in active and sham blocks with EEG (R1253). No sibling protocol yet.

classes: negative-peak triggered; positive-peak triggered; random phase
cue: none
stimulus_coding: real-time EEG phase-locked triggering of TMS pulses (mu rhythm)
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: each TMS pulse triggered by the real-time mu-rhythm phase (brain-state-dependent, pulse-wise closed loop), compared with random-phase stimulation (Zrenner et al. 2018). No sibling protocol yet.

name_zh: 正中神经体感诱发电位
cue: none
stimulus_coding: brief electrical pulses at a low repetition rate
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: low-rate median-nerve pulses averaged for the N20 (Dawson 1947). No sibling protocol yet.

name_zh: 经颅交流电刺激同步脑电
name_en: Transcranial alternating current stimulation with EEG
classes: tACS at the individual alpha frequency; sham
cue: none
stimulus_coding: sinusoidal current at a fixed frequency
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: fixed-frequency tACS vs sham with EEG before and after stimulation (Zaehle et al. 2010). No sibling protocol yet; closed-loop phase-locked tACS is not split (no lead).

cue: visual oddball task during stimulation
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: taVNS vs earlobe sham with a concurrent oddball task for the P3b (Ventura-Bort et al. 2018). No sibling protocol yet.

name_zh: 经颅直流电刺激同步记录
name_en: Transcranial direct current stimulation with EEG / fNIRS
cue: none
stimulus_coding: constant current for several minutes
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: polarity-dependent offline tDCS with recordings before/during/after (Nitsche & Paulus 2000, MEP origin, D-031). No sibling protocol yet.

classes: single TMS pulse to a cortical target
cue: none
stimulus_coding: single pulses, responses averaged
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: single-pulse TMS with TMS-compatible EEG and averaging (Ilmoniemi et al. 1997). No sibling protocol yet.

cue: task during stimulation
stimulus_coding: two kHz currents with a small frequency difference
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: TI targeting the hippocampus with BOLD readout during a task (R1129). No sibling protocol yet.

name_zh: TMS 与功能磁共振同步
classes: TMS interleaved with image acquisition; no-TMS / sham baseline
cue: none
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: TMS trains interleaved with echo-planar imaging, BOLD at the stimulated and connected regions (Bohning et al. 1998). No sibling protocol yet.

classes: focused ultrasound time-locked to median-nerve stimulation; sham sonication
cue: none
stimulus_coding: ultrasound pulse time-locked to a peripheral sensory stimulus
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: TUS of S1 delivered with median-nerve stimulation, SEP readout (Legon et al. 2014). Sibling proposed in split_log: TUS alone with fMRI readout (criterion 2; no checked lead).

cue: none
stimulus_coding: high-frequency vibration of a tendon
distinguishing: Standard configuration (earliest published) / 标准配置（最早发表）: tendon vibration inducing kinaesthetic illusion vs nearby skin vibration in fMRI (R1130; origin not established). No sibling protocol yet.
